items.title: 〈焦點股〉玉晶光攜美商3M推進擴束光學 攻上1245元新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yujing Optical Teams Up with US 3M to Advance Expanded Beam Optics, Rises to a New High of NT$1,245
paras: 光學精密元件廠玉晶光(3406-TW)確定將攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術（Expanded Beam Optical, EBO）解決方案的研發、製造與產能擴充，3M對玉晶光以私募增資股款48.13億元已匯入，取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權，玉晶光股價(27)逆勢上漲，盤中最高價達1245元創新天價。
玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。
玉晶光自結2026年第三季稅後純益10.92億元，每股9.69元，加計上半年財報後稅後純益26.69億元，每股純益達23.68元。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光以精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
paras_en: Optical precision component maker Yujing Optical (3406‑TW) confirmed it will partner with US‑based 3M to develop, manufacture, and expand capacity for Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions. 3M has transferred a private‑placement capital injection of NT$4.813 billion to Yujing Optical, acquiring roughly 4.68% of the company’s shares. The stock (27) rose against the market trend, reaching a session high of NT$1,245, a record peak.

Yujing Optical reported September 2026 revenue of NT$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, revenue totaled NT$19.631 billion, a 10.21% year‑over‑year increase. The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, delivered robust single‑quarter revenue of NT$7.816 billion, entering a historic high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year.

Yujing Optical posted third‑quarter 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.092 billion, or NT$9.69 per share. Including the first half of the year’s results, the cumulative after‑tax net profit reached NT$2.669 billion, or NT$23.68 earnings per share.

The large‑scale collaboration between Yujing Optical and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing Optical’s precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑accuracy assembly expertise. Yujing Optical’s production team will fully support the mass production of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉AMAX-KY 9月獲利1.04億元年增51倍 一度攻漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: AMAX‑KY September profit NT$104 million, up 51‑fold YoY, briefly hits limit‑up
paras: AMAX-KY(6933-TW)受惠亞洲及美國市場需求暢旺，9月稅後純益達1.04億元，年增51倍，每股純益2.45元，年增60.25倍，激勵AMAX-KY今(27)日股價走揚，漲停打開。
AMAX-KY今天早盤以411.5元開高走高，盤中衝上漲停價415.5元，雖隨後漲停打開，但截至午盤，股價暫報400元，仍大漲逾半根停板，並站回5日線及月線，成交量超過2000張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超196張。
AMAX-KY近日公告自結財務數字，9月營收14.28億元，年增2.29倍；稅後純益1.04億元，年增51倍；每股純益2.45元，年增60.25倍。第三季營收42.24億元，年增2.05倍；稅後純益3.04億元，年增24.33倍；每股純益7.16元，年增23.69倍。
AMAX-KY持續受惠亞洲與美國市場需求強勁，並逐步增加產能，台灣中壢廠擴產的產能將於本季完工，預計今年底至明年初開始貢獻，屆時中壢廠產能將較現有翻倍。
AMAX-KY將持續鎖定四大目標市場，包括NeoCloud基礎設施市場、企業地端與私有AI基礎設施、先進運算平台，以及AI資料中心建置市場。
paras_en: AMAX‑KY (6933‑TW) benefited from strong demand in Asian and U.S. markets, posting a September after‑tax net profit of NT$104 million, a 51‑fold year‑over‑year increase. Earnings per share were NT$2.45, up 60.25‑fold YoY, spurring the stock to rise on the 27th, breaking the limit‑up ceiling.

In early trading today, AMAX‑KY opened at NT$411.5 and surged to the limit‑up price of NT$415.5. Although the limit was later lifted, the share was still reported at about NT$400 by midday, more than a half‑limit increase, and it reclaimed the 5‑day and monthly moving averages with volume exceeding 2,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they net sold 196 lots last week.

AMAX‑KY recently disclosed its self‑compiled financials: September revenue was NT$1.428 billion, up 2.29‑fold YoY; after‑tax net profit was NT$104 million, up 51‑fold; EPS was NT$2.45, up 60.25‑fold. For the third quarter, revenue reached NT$4.224 billion, up 2.05‑fold; after‑tax net profit was NT$304 million, up 24.33‑fold; EPS was NT$7.16, up 23.69‑fold.

AMAX‑KY continues to benefit from robust demand in Asian and U.S. markets and is gradually expanding capacity. The expansion of its Zhongli plant in Taiwan will be completed this quarter and is expected to start contributing by the end of this year to early next year, at which point the Zhongli plant’s capacity will double the current level.

AMAX‑KY will keep targeting four major markets: the NeoCloud infrastructure market, enterprise‑edge and private AI infrastructure, advanced computing platforms, and AI data‑center construction market.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉美系外資調高緯穎目標價 價量齊揚漲逾半根停板
items.title_en: Focus Stock: US investors raise Wistron NeWeb target price, price and volume surge, up over half a limit-up
paras: 美系外資近日上調緯穎目標價至4000元，並看好緯穎AI伺服器動能，且動能從第四季延續至明年，激勵緯穎(6669-TW)今(27)日無懼大盤表現弱勢，價量齊揚，大漲逾半根停板。
緯穎今天早盤以1895元開高走高，盤中最高漲至1945元，大漲逾半根停板，截至午盤，股價暫報1925元，漲幅超過4%，成交量超過3000張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超465元。
緯穎最新財務表現優於市場預期，9月營收1726.2億元，月增19.62%，年增99.99%，創歷史單月歷史新高；第三季營收4346.18億元，季增56.25%，年增62.89%，創歷史單季新高；累計今年前三季營收9892.78億元，年增50.3%。
美系外資持續看好緯穎AI伺服器動能，並預期第四季營收可望年增雙位數。美系外資指出，動能來自ASIC AI伺服器放量、代理式AI推升傳統伺服器需求穩健、GPU第四季量產，以及ASIC AI伺服器有望斬獲新客戶。
paras_en: US investors have recently raised Wistron NeWeb's (6669‑TW) target price to NT$4,000 and are optimistic about the momentum of its AI servers, expecting the momentum to continue from Q4 into next year. This confidence helped Wistron NeWeb ignore the weak broader market today (Oct 27), with both price and volume climbing and the stock jumping more than half a limit‑up move.

In early trading this morning, Wistron NeWeb opened at NT$1,895 and rose higher, reaching a intraday high of NT$1,945—more than half a limit‑up increase. By the midday session, the price was reported at NT$1,925, up over 4%, with trading volume exceeding 3,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they collectively sold NT$465 worth of shares last week.

Wistron NeWeb's latest financial results beat market expectations. In September, revenue reached NT$172.62 billion, up 19.62% month‑over‑month and 99.99% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record. For the third quarter, revenue was NT$434.618 billion, up 56.25% quarter‑over‑quarter and 62.89% year‑over‑year, a historic quarterly high. Cumulatively, the first three quarters of the year generated NT$989.278 billion in revenue, a 50.3% increase year‑over‑year.

US investors remain bullish on Wistron NeWeb's AI server momentum and expect double‑digit year‑over‑year revenue growth in Q4. They attribute the momentum to increased shipments of ASIC AI servers, proxy‑type AI boosting steady demand for traditional servers, mass production of GPUs in Q4, and the prospect of ASIC AI servers winning new customers.

items.title: 光通訊股強勢反彈！Lumentum大漲8.19%　AI需求、中國供應限制成利多
items.title_en: Optical Communications Stocks Rally Strongly! Lumentum Jumps 8.19% – AI Demand and China Supply Restrictions Are Catalysts
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續支撐光通訊產業，美國光學元件廠商股價週一（26日）強勢反彈。Lumentum(LITE-US) 收漲8.19%，領漲標普500指數成分股；同業 Coherent(COHR-US) 上漲5.83%，Ciena(CIEN-US) 也上漲4.89%。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Evercore ISI 分析師 Amit Daryanani 指出，上週光通訊類股遭遇賣壓後，市場對該產業重新燃起興趣。
他表示，許多投資人可能也一直在等待人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 公布首次公開募股（IPO）的 S-1 註冊文件，之後才重新大舉投入相關交易。
Anthropic 週一已提交 IPO 申請文件，財務資料整體上也為晶片類股帶來提振。
Daryanani 表示，目前 AI 產業公布的財報，從基本面來看仍「相對健康」。此外，Meta(META-US) 宣布發行股票籌資，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 則承諾投入400億美元融資，用於採購晶片及其他 AI 硬體。
這些消息讓投資人在週一看到了 AI 投資交易「持續具備韌性」的跡象。
除了 AI 投資動能，潛在的美國進口限制措施，也成為光通訊產業的另一項利多因素。Daryanani 也提到，市場預期美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）將於明年初限制從海外供應商進口光收發器。
他表示，這項決策「將實質上把中國供應商排除在美國新一代3.2T光收發器市場之外」。
Daryanani 引述一名專家指出，考慮到中國生產的這類元件約占全球總產量的三分之二，相關限制將產生重大影響。
Daryanani 表示，這將為 AI 基礎建設的部署帶來挑戰，但另一方面，任何針對中國的限制措施，都將使美國製造商及其盟友供應商受益。
他指出，亞洲市場週末傳出的另一項關鍵消息，是半導體材料磷化銦（Indium phosphide，InP）的供應增長可能放緩。
Daryanani 認為，這顯示中國供應商在擴大磷化銦產能方面可能面臨挑戰，難以提供足夠符合目前傳輸速度要求的產品。
Daryanani 指出，傳統光通訊產業的景氣循環通常約為5年，但 AI 發展改變了產業節奏，資料傳輸通道的速度幾乎每年都在提升。
Daryanani 指出，傳輸通道速度加快，加上 AI 資料中心所需的互連數量持續增加，應會繼續推動光通訊元件需求。他也表示，資料中心對連接能力的需求增加，將帶動雷射元件需求成長，包括採用磷化銦製造的雷射。
然而，擴充製造產能及完成產品認證均需要時間，短期內供應仍可能受限。Daryanani 認為，在需求持續成長、供應擴張速度有限的情況下，具備擴產能力、且能交付符合高速傳輸規格產品的供應商，將持續受惠。
paras_en: AI infrastructure demand continues to support the optical communications industry, and U.S. optical component makers saw a strong rebound on Monday (the 26th). Lumentum (LITE-US) rose 8.19%, leading the S&P 500 constituents; peer Coherent (COHR-US) gained 5.83% and Ciena (CIEN-US) climbed 4.89%.
According to Barron's, Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said that after last week’s sell‑off in optical‑communications stocks, the market has rekindled interest in the sector.
He noted that many investors may have been waiting for the AI startup Anthropic to file its S‑1 registration statement for an IPO before re‑entering the space in force.
Anthropic submitted its IPO application on Monday, and its financial disclosures overall gave a boost to chip stocks.

Daryanani said that the AI industry’s recent earnings reports still look "relatively healthy" on a fundamentals basis. In addition, Meta (META-US) announced a stock offering, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) pledged $40 billion in financing for chip and other AI‑hardware purchases.
These developments gave investors on Monday a sign that AI‑related trading remains resilient.

Beyond AI momentum, a potential U.S. import‑restriction measure is another tailwind for the optical‑communications sector. Daryanani added that the market expects the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to restrict imports of optical transceivers from overseas suppliers early next year.
He said that the decision would "effectively exclude Chinese suppliers from the U.S. next‑generation 3.2‑Tbps optical transceiver market."
Citing an expert, Daryanani noted that Chinese manufacturers account for roughly two‑thirds of global production of these components, so the restriction would have a major impact.
He said this will pose challenges for AI‑infrastructure deployment, but any restrictions on China will benefit U.S. manufacturers and their allied suppliers.
He pointed out another key weekend development in Asia: the supply growth of the semiconductor material indium phosphide (InP) may be slowing.
Daryanani believes this indicates Chinese suppliers could struggle to expand InP capacity and may be unable to meet the product specifications required for current transmission speeds.

He explained that the traditional optical‑communications industry follows a roughly five‑year cyclical pattern, but AI development is reshaping the rhythm, with data‑channel speeds improving almost every year.

He added that faster transmission channels and the growing number of interconnects needed by AI data centers will continue to drive demand for optical‑communication components, including lasers made from indium phosphide.

However, expanding manufacturing capacity and completing product certifications take time, so short‑term supply may remain constrained. Daryanani believes that, with demand rising and supply expansion limited, suppliers capable of scaling production and delivering high‑speed‑spec products will continue to benefit.

items.title: 警示「人類毀滅風險」卻吸金千億美元 解析AI獨角獸Anthropic招股書
paras: 美國人工智慧(AI)獨角獸企業 Anthropic 正式向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)遞交 S-1 註冊文件，啟動首次公開募股(IPO)流程。公司申請在納斯達克全球精選市場掛牌，股票代碼定為「ANT」。
據知情人士透露，Anthropic 預計最快於 2026 年 11 月 16 日當周上市。本次 IPO 預計籌集資金高達 1,000 億美元甚至更多，上市估值上看 1.5 兆至 2 兆美元。若以 2 兆美元上限計算，Anthropic 將一舉超越 SpaceX，刷新全球歷史上規模最大的 IPO 紀錄。

半年營收狂飆162億美元與巨額帳面虧損

招股書揭露了 Anthropic 成立以來極為罕見的財務擴張速度。公司營收從 2023 年的 4,100 萬美元跳升至 2024 年的 3.86 億美元，並於 2025 年達到 45.85 億美元。到了 2026 年上半年，Anthropic 營收已爆發性成長至 162.86 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 11.63 億美元大增約 1,300%(約 14 倍)。
按最新營收推算，其年化收入運行率已達 650 億美元規模。其中，基於用量計費(pay-for-intelligence)的消費型收入占總營收約 80%(131 億美元)，訂閱收入占 20%(32 億美元)。
然而，伴隨驚人營收成長的是龐大的 GAAP 淨虧損。2025 年全年淨虧損為 419.65 億美元，而 2026 年上半年淨虧損更擴大至 807.48 億美元。
招股書特別說明，2026 年上半年的淨虧損中，有高達 723.88 億美元(近 90%)源自可轉換公司債、衍生負債及未來股權簡單協議(SAFE)公允價值變動所產生的非現金損失。主因是公司私人市場估值暴漲，導致未償還可轉換公司債的帳面估值大幅推高，並非經營層面的實質現金失血。
若回歸實際本業經營，Anthropic 的營業虧損已明顯收窄：2026 年上半年營業虧損降至 6.93 億美元(2025 年同期為 21.35 億美元)；剔除股票薪酬等項目後，2026 年上半年調整後營業利潤轉正達到 16.18 億美元，營業利潤率達 10%。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 帳上持有高達 1,316.51 億美元的現金、現金等價物及短期投資，資金儲備充裕。

淨收入留存率高達 900%

在商業化拓展上，Anthropic 展現出對企業客戶的強大吸引力。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，其合格企業客戶的淨收入留存率(NRR)約為 900%，意味著既有客戶在嵌入關鍵業務工作流後，消費金額呈現指數級放大。
招股書揭露了 Anthropic 企業客戶的三層台階：

年貢獻收入 ≥ 10 萬美元的客戶超過 11,900 家(一年前僅約 950 家)。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 100 萬美元的客戶超過 1,900 家。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 1,000 萬美元的巨型客戶約 250 家。


在大型企業覆蓋率方面，《財富》500 強(Fortune 500)已有超過 50% 的企業成為 Anthropic 的付費客戶，全球 2000 強(Global 2000)覆蓋率超過 30%，《財富》前 10 強企業更是 100% 採用。產品陣容除了 Claude 基礎模型平台外，亦包含專為軟體開發設計的 AI 智慧體(AI Agent)Claude Code，以及面向知識工作者的 Claude Cowork。
隨著企業大規模調用，Anthropic 過去 12 個月的人均營收從 140 萬美元躍升至 660 萬美元以上，全公司員工數約 5,300 人。

招股書警示「人類毀滅風險」

令人關注的是，Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中列出了長達 93 頁的風險因素(從第 26 頁至第 119 頁)。相較之下，SpaceX 的風險因素僅 37 頁，微軟為 40 頁，Coinbase 為 60 頁。
1. 官方警告與「模型失齊」事件
Anthropic 在招股書第 46 頁明確寫道：
「若缺乏適當的安全防護、監督與安全措施，充分先進的人工智慧系統在開發、部署及運作過程中，可能會對人類造成毀滅性或存在性風險(catastrophic or existential risks to humanity)。」
公司同時承認已觀察到模型出現「未對齊(misaligned)」的異常行為。招股書透露，在一項內部測試中，早期版本模型在無法終止一項不可能完成的任务後，竟自行利用搜尋到的密碼，未經授權取得第三方系統的管理員權限、蒐集憑證、變更系統設定並讀取個人隱私資料。
Anthropic 坦言，實施預防性安全措施或延後模型發布，可能會削弱其相較於未受限競爭對手的優勢，並對營收成長造成不利影響。
2. 外部評論
對此，知名 AI 評論家、紐約大學(NYU)名譽教授馬庫斯(Gary Marcus)在社群平台 X 上發表強烈批評，指責 Anthropic 在招股書中故意刻意隱瞞數據、企圖「規避真相」：
馬庫斯指出：「Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中迴避了第三季度的財務數據。這種省略說明了一切——需求正在下降，經濟效益並未改善。一家標榜以信任為核心建構的公司，現在卻試圖規避真相(skirt the truth)。」
另一方面，佛羅里達大學 IPO 計畫主任、被譽為「IPO 先生」的Jay Ritter在接受《USA TODAY》採訪時分析，一般公司在招股書中警告的通常是利率或油價上漲，Anthropic 的做法極為罕見。
Ritter表示：「任何公司都不常見在風險章節中表達對產品可能導致『大規模滅絕事件』的擔憂……在公開說明書中將其列為風險因素是非常罕見的。」
Ritter進一步指出：「如果這是一個眼前真正的威脅，我們應該會看到全球金融資產價格暴跌，人們會想：『如果我明年就要死了，為什麼還要存錢？』但全球並未出現金融資產的大規模拋售，這表明雖然風險存在，但只要公司保持警惕並採取預防措施，投資人傾向認為事情不會發生。大家不必過度恐慌，因為公司已經在為此擔憂了。」

算力基礎設施與全球 AI 資本競賽

算力仍是 Anthropic 最沉重的剛性支出。2026 年上半年，其算力與基礎設施費用高達 89.45 億美元。不過效率指標顯示，2026 年第二季度營收同比成長 1,368% 的同時，算力費用僅成長 300%，顯示營收成長速度已超過算力成本的攀升幅度。新一代模型 Claude Opus 5.5 相較 Opus 5 也成功將客戶單次任務成本降低了約 40%。
在算力供應上，Anthropic 採用多晶片架構，同時調度 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、輝達 GPU 與 AMD GPU。同時，公司最大的戰略投資者與雲端夥伴亞馬遜與Google，均在 2026 年 5 月的 H 輪融資中分別追加了 50 億美元與 100 億美元的股權投資，並保留了數百億美元規模的可轉換公司債額度。

items.title: 暫停升息不代表緊縮循環結束 本週Fed會議有哪些重點？
items.title_en: A Pause in Rate Hikes Does Not Signal the End of Tightening Cycle: Key Points of This Week's Fed Meeting
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，市場普遍預期，美國聯準會(Fed)官員將在週三的會議上維持基準利率不變，釋出在對抗通膨方面採取耐心態度的訊號。
根據 CME Group 的 FedWatch 工具，金融市場目前認為，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在這週的會議上投票決定升息 0.25 個百分點的機率約為 10%。
近幾週，聯準會官員公開討論是否應在 9 月升息 0.25 個百分點後，再次升息，以因應高於預期的通膨。儘管部分官員表達了擔憂，但也有其他官員主張採取觀望態度。
聯邦資金利率上升，意味著各類貸款的借貸成本都會提高，這可能抑制消費支出，進而壓低通膨。不過，升息也可能對就業市場及整體經濟造成拖累。
聯準會必須在國會賦予的雙重使命之間取得平衡，也就是維持低通膨與高就業率。通膨目前已連續第五年高於聯準會的目標，而失業率則徘徊在歷史低點附近。多數專家預期，即使聯準會放棄在 10 月升息，仍可能在 12 月再次升息。
牛津經濟研究院 (Oxford Economics) 首席美國經濟學家Michael Pearce在一篇評論中寫道，「所有跡象都顯示，聯準會短期內可能仍需要持續升息。然而，幾位關鍵官員近期的發言暗示，聯準會不太可能在 10 月的政策會議上採取升息行動。」
聯邦公開市場委員會的兩位重要成員——聯準會理事鮑曼 (Michelle Bowman)及紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John C. Williams)——近期的談話都暗示，他們並不傾向在連續兩次會議上都升息。
高盛首席美國經濟學家 David Mericle 在評論中指出，近期聯準會官員的發言顯示，多數官員可能支持每隔一次會議升息 0.25 個百分點。若採取這種節奏，接下來兩次升息將分別落在 12 月與明年 3 月。
除了利率決策之外，週三會議最受關注的環節，將是聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 舉行的記者會。不過，如果華許維持一貫作風，他將避免透露未來貨幣政策決策的線索。與過去的聯準會主席不同，華許一直採取不向金融市場提供「前瞻指引」的政策。
即便如此，他的談話即使有所保留，仍可能透露一些重要訊息。
野村證券經濟學家Ruchir Sharma在評論中寫道，「華許主席不太可能在記者會上直接提供任何前瞻指引，但我們預期，他將以間接方式支持 12 月升息。」
他進一步指出，「華許如何描述近期的通膨數據與金融市場狀況，可能提供一些線索，讓我們了解聯準會在 2027 年進一步緊縮貨幣政策的門檻。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that the market broadly expects Federal Reserve officials to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at Wednesday’s meeting, signaling a patient stance in the fight against inflation.

According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, financial markets currently assign roughly a 10% probability that the Federal Open Market Committee will vote to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point at this week’s meeting.

In recent weeks, Fed officials have publicly debated whether to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point in September and then again to address inflation that is running hotter than expected. While some officials voiced concerns, others advocated a wait‑and‑see approach.

Higher federal funds rates mean higher borrowing costs across all types of loans, which could dampen consumer spending and thus ease inflation. However, rate hikes could also weigh on the labor market and the broader economy.

The Fed must balance its dual mandate from Congress—maintaining low inflation and high employment. Inflation has now been above the Fed’s target for a fifth consecutive year, while unemployment hovers near historic lows. Most experts expect that even if the Fed skips a hike in October, it may raise rates again in December.

Oxford Economics chief U.S. economist Michael Pearce wrote in a commentary that “all signs point to the Fed likely needing to keep raising rates in the short term. Yet, recent remarks by several key officials suggest the Fed is unlikely to hike at the October policy meeting.”

Two prominent members of the Federal Open Market Committee—Fed Governor Michelle Bowman and New York Fed President John C. Williams—have recently hinted that they are not inclined to raise rates at two consecutive meetings.

Goldman Sachs chief U.S. economist David Mericle noted that recent comments from Fed officials indicate most may favor a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike every other meeting. At that pace, the next two hikes would fall in December and March of next year.

Beyond the rate decision, the most closely watched part of Wednesday’s meeting will be the press conference held by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. However, if Warsh sticks to his usual style, he will avoid giving clues about future monetary‑policy decisions. Unlike past Fed chairs, Warsh has consistently refrained from providing “forward guidance” to financial markets.
Even so, his remarks—though guarded—could still reveal some important information.

Nomura Securities economist Ruchir Sharma wrote that “Chair Warsh is unlikely to give any direct forward guidance at the press conference, but we expect he will indirectly support a December rate hike.”
He added that “how Warsh describes recent inflation data and financial‑market conditions may provide clues about the thresholds for further tightening by the Fed in 2027.”

items.title: 與SpaceX合併有戲 特斯拉賣出評等占比創11年新低
items.title_en: Merger Talk with SpaceX Sparks Hope; Tesla's Sell Rating Share Hits 11-Year Low
paras: 隨著特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 備受期待的合併案逐漸接近成真，分析師對這家電動車廠的股價展望迅速轉趨樂觀，給予特斯拉股票悲觀評等的分析師占比，已降至逾 11 年來最低。
法國巴黎銀行與里昂證券分析師上周分別將評等從相當於「賣出」調升至「中立」與「持有」。巴克萊周一(26日)跟進，將評等從相當於「持有」調升至「買進」。特斯拉股價周一上漲 5.2%。
巴克萊分析師 Dan Levy 在報告中寫道：「市場預期的合併案如今已成為看好特斯拉的重要理由，因為這為股價帶來上漲空間。」
馬斯克表示，特斯拉與 SpaceX 董事會已成立特別委員會，評估交易效益，讓合併熱潮升至高點。早在 SpaceX 今年 6 月上市前，華爾街就已關注馬斯克旗下這兩家最大企業合併的可能性。
法國巴黎銀行分析師 James Picariello 在報告中表示，潛在合併案如今已成為「主導估值的考量因素」，儘管他對特斯拉的現金消耗與 AI 發展速度仍抱持審慎態度。
他將目標價從 266 美元調高至 420 美元，「完全」反映 SpaceX 收購特斯拉的可能性升高。
Zacks Investment Research 策略師 Andrew Rocco 在報告中寫道：「若要讓合併案獲准，兩家公司的獨立特別委員會必須協商出合理的交易條件。假設收購溢價為 25%，特斯拉每股價值將約為 500 美元。」
彭博追蹤的 60 名分析師中，僅 5 人建議賣出特斯拉股票，悲觀評等占比創 2015 年初以來最低。相較之下，今年 1 月 1 日的 71 名分析師中，有 15 人給予賣出評等。
儘管今年賣出評等占比下降，買進評等占比仍相對穩定。特斯拉股價今年以來下跌 13%，同期標普 500 指數則上漲 12%。
特斯拉目標遠大，但過去屢次延後實現承諾，讓投資人與分析師難以確定，其 AI 計畫何時能帶來回報，甚至能否實現。
即使沒有合併案，特斯拉業務也已處於轉折點，馬斯克正試圖透過自駕計程車與機器人助理，將公司從電動車製造商轉型為實體 AI 的先驅。
同樣積極進軍 AI 的 SpaceX，今年稍早已將馬斯克旗下 xAI 納入旗下，並已與特斯拉合作推動 Terafab 晶片製造計畫，以及號稱能對抗地心引力的 Roadster 等特殊工程產品。兩家公司若合併，可能催生一家由馬斯克掌舵、價值 3.6 兆美元的 AI 集團。
特斯拉上周公布的第三季獲利優於預期，但因下修 2026 年全年支出預估，股價出現震盪，投資人質疑公司投入的資金是否足以達成目標。
不過，巴克萊分析師 Levy 表示，這份財報在核心汽車業務與自駕計程車領域，釋出「多項足以支撐股價走強的重要利多」。
paras_en: As the much‑anticipated merger between Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) draws nearer to reality, analysts have become quickly more optimistic about the EV maker’s stock outlook, driving the share of analysts assigning a sell rating to a low not seen in over 11 years.

BNP Paribas and Lyon Securities analysts each upgraded their ratings last week from a sell‑equivalent to neutral and hold, respectively. Barclays followed on Monday the 26th, raising its rating from a hold‑equivalent to buy. Tesla’s share price rose 5.2% on Monday.
Barclays analyst Dan Levy wrote in his report: “The market‑expected merger has now become a key bullish catalyst for Tesla, as it adds upside potential to the stock.”

Elon Musk said that a special committee has been formed by the Tesla and SpaceX boards to evaluate the deal’s merits, pushing merger enthusiasm to a peak. Wall Street had been eyeing the possibility of combining Musk’s two biggest companies even before SpaceX’s June IPO this year.

BNP Paribas analyst James Picariello noted in his note that the potential merger has become the “dominant valuation factor,” though he remains cautious about Tesla’s cash burn and the pace of its AI development.
He raised the target price from $266 to $420, fully reflecting the heightened probability of a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla.

Zacks Investment Research strategist Andrew Rocco wrote: “For the merger to be approved, the independent special committees of both companies must negotiate reasonable deal terms. Assuming a 25% acquisition premium, Tesla’s per‑share value would be roughly $500.”

Among the 60 analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only five recommend selling Tesla shares, marking the lowest sell‑rating proportion since early 2015. By contrast, of the 71 analysts on Jan. 1, 15 had issued sell ratings.
Even though the sell‑rating share has fallen this year, the buy‑rating share remains relatively stable. Tesla’s stock is down 13% year‑to‑date, while the S&P 500 has risen 12% over the same period.
Tesla’s ambitions are lofty, but repeated delays in delivering on promises have left investors and analysts uncertain about when its AI initiatives will pay off, or even if they will materialize.

Even without a merger, Tesla’s business is at a turning point, with Musk trying to pivot the company from an electric‑vehicle maker to a pioneer of embodied AI through autonomous taxis and robot assistants.

SpaceX, also aggressively pursuing AI, recently folded Musk’s xAI under its umbrella and has partnered with Tesla on the Terafab chip‑manufacturing project and on special‑engineered products such as the purported gravity‑defying Roadster. A merger could spawn a Musk‑run AI conglomerate valued at $3.6 trillion.

Tesla reported third‑quarter earnings last week that beat expectations, but the stock wavered after the company cut its full‑year 2026 spending outlook, prompting investors to question whether its capital allocation is sufficient to meet its goals.

Nevertheless, Barclays analyst Levy said the earnings release delivered “multiple significant positives in the core automotive and autonomous‑taxi segments that are enough to support a stronger stock.”

items.title: Jefferies看半導體設備旺到2028年 AI投資疑慮擋不住需求
items.title_en: Jefferies Sees Semiconductor Equipment Demand Strong Through 2028, AI Investment Concerns Won’t Damp Demand
paras: Jefferies 預期，儘管市場對 AI 投資、資料中心建設及記憶體價格的疑慮為半導體產業帶來壓力，半導體生產設備市場仍將持續擴張至 2028 年。
半導體業者與設備大廠在9月結束的季度財報中，對營運基本面展現出更強的信心；然而，股票市場對未來風險的擔憂，卻拉大了當前營運表現與股價預期之間的落差。
近期市場關注的焦點，包含超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）資本支出的永續性、資料中心面臨的電力限制與施工延宕、主要AI巨頭之間的財務連結，以及居高不下的記憶體價格。
此外，關於生成式AI投資報酬率的質疑，以及日益自主化的AI系統所帶來的風險，也再度浮上檯面。
不過，Jefferies 預期，隨著 AI 應用日益普及，將持續支撐資料中心所需的繪圖處理器（GPU）、客製化晶片、中央處理器（CPU）、功率半導體及其他零組件需求，記憶體需求也可望持續成長。
半導體公司與客戶簽訂的長期供應協議，提高了中期需求能見度，也支持設備製造商對成長延續至 2028 年的預期。
Jefferies 預估，晶圓製造設備市場規模在 2027 年最高可達 2,000 億美元，2028 年約為 2,200 億美元，相較投資人對這兩年的預估分別為 2,000 億美元與 2,500 億美元，可能略顯保守。儘管如此，該市場仍可望維持強勁成長至 2028 年。
個股評等方面，Jefferies 給予應用材料(AMAT-US) 、科林研發(LRCX-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)「買進」評等；對ASML(ASML-US) 與 SCREEN Holdings(DINRF-US)則給予「持有」評等。
paras_en: Jefferies expects that despite market concerns over AI investment, data‑center construction and memory prices putting pressure on the semiconductor industry, the semiconductor manufacturing equipment market will continue to expand through 2028.

Semiconductor companies and major equipment makers showed stronger confidence in their operating fundamentals in the quarterly earnings reports that ended in September, yet the stock market’s worries about future risks have widened the gap between current operating performance and stock‑price expectations.

Recent market focus includes the sustainability of capital spending by hyperscalers, power constraints and construction delays at data centers, financial linkages among leading AI giants, and persistently high memory prices.
In addition, questions about the return on investment for generative‑AI and the risks posed by increasingly autonomous AI systems have resurfaced.

Nevertheless, Jefferies expects that as AI applications become more widespread, they will continue to support demand for GPUs, custom chips, CPUs, power semiconductors and other components needed by data centers, and memory demand is also expected to keep growing.
Long‑term supply agreements signed between semiconductor firms and their customers have improved mid‑term demand visibility and support equipment manufacturers’ outlook for growth through 2028.

Jefferies projects the wafer‑fab equipment market could reach up to $200 billion in 2027 and about $220 billion in 2028, compared with investors’ forecasts of $200 billion and $250 billion for those years, suggesting a slightly more conservative view. Nonetheless, the market is still expected to maintain strong growth through 2028.

For individual stock ratings, Jefferies gives a “Buy” rating to Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Lam Research (LRCX‑US), NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US), and a “Hold” rating to ASML (ASML‑US) and SCREEN Holdings (DINRF‑US).

items.title: 〈焦點股〉玉晶光攜美商3M推進擴束光學 攻上1245元新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yujing Optical Teams Up with US 3M to Advance Expanded Beam Optics, Rises to a New High of NT$1,245
paras: 光學精密元件廠玉晶光(3406-TW)確定將攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術（Expanded Beam Optical, EBO）解決方案的研發、製造與產能擴充，3M對玉晶光以私募增資股款48.13億元已匯入，取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權，玉晶光股價(27)逆勢上漲，盤中最高價達1245元創新天價。
玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。
玉晶光自結2026年第三季稅後純益10.92億元，每股9.69元，加計上半年財報後稅後純益26.69億元，每股純益達23.68元。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光以精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
paras_en: Optical precision component maker Yujing Optical (3406‑TW) confirmed it will partner with US‑based 3M to develop, manufacture, and expand capacity for Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions. 3M has transferred a private‑placement capital injection of NT$4.813 billion to Yujing Optical, acquiring roughly 4.68% of the company’s shares. The stock (27) rose against the market trend, reaching a session high of NT$1,245, a record peak.

Yujing Optical reported September 2026 revenue of NT$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, revenue totaled NT$19.631 billion, a 10.21% year‑over‑year increase. The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, delivered robust single‑quarter revenue of NT$7.816 billion, entering a historic high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year.

Yujing Optical posted third‑quarter 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.092 billion, or NT$9.69 per share. Including the first half of the year’s results, the cumulative after‑tax net profit reached NT$2.669 billion, or NT$23.68 earnings per share.

The large‑scale collaboration between Yujing Optical and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing Optical’s precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑accuracy assembly expertise. Yujing Optical’s production team will fully support the mass production of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉AMAX-KY 9月獲利1.04億元年增51倍 一度攻漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: AMAX‑KY September profit NT$104 million, up 51‑fold YoY, briefly hits limit‑up
paras: AMAX-KY(6933-TW)受惠亞洲及美國市場需求暢旺，9月稅後純益達1.04億元，年增51倍，每股純益2.45元，年增60.25倍，激勵AMAX-KY今(27)日股價走揚，漲停打開。
AMAX-KY今天早盤以411.5元開高走高，盤中衝上漲停價415.5元，雖隨後漲停打開，但截至午盤，股價暫報400元，仍大漲逾半根停板，並站回5日線及月線，成交量超過2000張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超196張。
AMAX-KY近日公告自結財務數字，9月營收14.28億元，年增2.29倍；稅後純益1.04億元，年增51倍；每股純益2.45元，年增60.25倍。第三季營收42.24億元，年增2.05倍；稅後純益3.04億元，年增24.33倍；每股純益7.16元，年增23.69倍。
AMAX-KY持續受惠亞洲與美國市場需求強勁，並逐步增加產能，台灣中壢廠擴產的產能將於本季完工，預計今年底至明年初開始貢獻，屆時中壢廠產能將較現有翻倍。
AMAX-KY將持續鎖定四大目標市場，包括NeoCloud基礎設施市場、企業地端與私有AI基礎設施、先進運算平台，以及AI資料中心建置市場。
paras_en: AMAX‑KY (6933‑TW) benefited from strong demand in Asian and U.S. markets, posting a September after‑tax net profit of NT$104 million, a 51‑fold year‑over‑year increase. Earnings per share were NT$2.45, up 60.25‑fold YoY, spurring the stock to rise on the 27th, breaking the limit‑up ceiling.

In early trading today, AMAX‑KY opened at NT$411.5 and surged to the limit‑up price of NT$415.5. Although the limit was later lifted, the share was still reported at about NT$400 by midday, more than a half‑limit increase, and it reclaimed the 5‑day and monthly moving averages with volume exceeding 2,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they net sold 196 lots last week.

AMAX‑KY recently disclosed its self‑compiled financials: September revenue was NT$1.428 billion, up 2.29‑fold YoY; after‑tax net profit was NT$104 million, up 51‑fold; EPS was NT$2.45, up 60.25‑fold. For the third quarter, revenue reached NT$4.224 billion, up 2.05‑fold; after‑tax net profit was NT$304 million, up 24.33‑fold; EPS was NT$7.16, up 23.69‑fold.

AMAX‑KY continues to benefit from robust demand in Asian and U.S. markets and is gradually expanding capacity. The expansion of its Zhongli plant in Taiwan will be completed this quarter and is expected to start contributing by the end of this year to early next year, at which point the Zhongli plant’s capacity will double the current level.

AMAX‑KY will keep targeting four major markets: the NeoCloud infrastructure market, enterprise‑edge and private AI infrastructure, advanced computing platforms, and AI data‑center construction market.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉美系外資調高緯穎目標價 價量齊揚漲逾半根停板
items.title_en: Focus Stock: US investors raise Wistron NeWeb target price, price and volume surge, up over half a limit-up
paras: 美系外資近日上調緯穎目標價至4000元，並看好緯穎AI伺服器動能，且動能從第四季延續至明年，激勵緯穎(6669-TW)今(27)日無懼大盤表現弱勢，價量齊揚，大漲逾半根停板。
緯穎今天早盤以1895元開高走高，盤中最高漲至1945元，大漲逾半根停板，截至午盤，股價暫報1925元，漲幅超過4%，成交量超過3000張。至於三大法人近日籌碼動向，上周合計賣超465元。
緯穎最新財務表現優於市場預期，9月營收1726.2億元，月增19.62%，年增99.99%，創歷史單月歷史新高；第三季營收4346.18億元，季增56.25%，年增62.89%，創歷史單季新高；累計今年前三季營收9892.78億元，年增50.3%。
美系外資持續看好緯穎AI伺服器動能，並預期第四季營收可望年增雙位數。美系外資指出，動能來自ASIC AI伺服器放量、代理式AI推升傳統伺服器需求穩健、GPU第四季量產，以及ASIC AI伺服器有望斬獲新客戶。
paras_en: US investors have recently raised Wistron NeWeb's (6669‑TW) target price to NT$4,000 and are optimistic about the momentum of its AI servers, expecting the momentum to continue from Q4 into next year. This confidence helped Wistron NeWeb ignore the weak broader market today (Oct 27), with both price and volume climbing and the stock jumping more than half a limit‑up move.

In early trading this morning, Wistron NeWeb opened at NT$1,895 and rose higher, reaching a intraday high of NT$1,945—more than half a limit‑up increase. By the midday session, the price was reported at NT$1,925, up over 4%, with trading volume exceeding 3,000 lots. Regarding the three major institutional investors, they collectively sold NT$465 worth of shares last week.

Wistron NeWeb's latest financial results beat market expectations. In September, revenue reached NT$172.62 billion, up 19.62% month‑over‑month and 99.99% year‑over‑year, setting a new single‑month record. For the third quarter, revenue was NT$434.618 billion, up 56.25% quarter‑over‑quarter and 62.89% year‑over‑year, a historic quarterly high. Cumulatively, the first three quarters of the year generated NT$989.278 billion in revenue, a 50.3% increase year‑over‑year.

US investors remain bullish on Wistron NeWeb's AI server momentum and expect double‑digit year‑over‑year revenue growth in Q4. They attribute the momentum to increased shipments of ASIC AI servers, proxy‑type AI boosting steady demand for traditional servers, mass production of GPUs in Q4, and the prospect of ASIC AI servers winning new customers.

items.title: 1萬元當AI股東！施羅德攜LINE Bank開放預購 首檔主動台股ETF 00419A 11/2開募
items.title_en: Invest 10,000 TWD as an AI Shareholder! Schroders Teams Up with LINE Bank to Open Pre‑Orders for First Active Taiwan‑Stock ETF 00419A, Fundraising Nov 2‑6
paras: 近期台股震盪加劇，但市場起伏未改變投資人對AI長線趨勢的信心。當AI已成投資主軸，更大的課題是下一步該布局什麼，才能跟上快速輪動、持續站在趨勢風口？施羅德投信認為，隨著AI商機從大型權值股向產業鏈更多領域擴散，市場愈是輪動，主動管理愈能發揮選股與靈活調整的價值，旗下首檔主動式台股ETF「施羅德AI科技台股主動式ETF基金(00419A-TW)」預計11月2日至6日展開募集，每受益權單位發行價新台幣10元，最低申購金額為新台幣1萬元，攜手LINE Bank合作即日起開放預購。
根據施羅德台股投資團隊分析，AI正重新形塑亞洲市場版圖，台灣與韓國受到AI浪潮帶動，已超越中國，成為MSCI新興市場指數中權重最大的兩個市場；另一方面，台韓市場集中度皆偏高，大型股票占指數權重較高。
進一步從產業結構觀察，台韓受惠AI的投資邏輯有所不同。施羅德台股團隊認為，韓國AI近期投資機會較著重供需失衡下的「稀缺性」，台灣則更聚焦技術迭代帶來的「規格升級」。隨著AI算力持續提升，台灣從半導體、PCB、散熱、高速傳輸、電源到基礎建設，各環節產品與技術持續升級，也讓AI投資機會沿著產業鏈向外延伸。

基本面亦提供支撐。施羅德投資團隊資料顯示，台灣8月出口金額由753億美元升至824億美元，刷新歷年單月新高，高階晶片、AI伺服器及關鍵零組件需求仍然強勁；市場對2026年上市公司獲利預估亦已連續15個月上修，其中AI需求為重要推力。當AI機會隨規格升級向不同產業環節移動，投資關鍵不只是掌握AI大方向，更在於辨識下一個受惠技術升級、具備獲利成長潛力的企業，這也讓主動研究、選股與動態調整有更大的發揮空間。
隨著AI從半導體向零組件、基礎建設及新應用延伸，投資版圖也更加多元。施羅德台股投資團隊認為相關機會將涵蓋AI半導體、AI裝置、AI基礎建設及AI新領域等不同面向。施羅德長期深耕台股主動投資，包括「施羅德台灣樂活中小基金」等既有產品；此次推出首檔主動式台股ETF 00419A，聚焦AI投資主題，透過施羅德台股投資團隊的基本面研究與主動選股，靈活掌握產業輪動下的成長機會。
基金投資流程從台股超過1,800檔股票池出發，先過濾股票品質，再結合AI投資主題，從產業趨勢、AI產業鏈定位及企業競爭力等面向進行評估，主動管理的價值不只是「選股票」，更在於知道機會往哪裡移動，並讓投資布局跟著動。
00419A預計於11月2日至6日展開募集，每受益權單位發行價新台幣10元，最低申購金額為新台幣1萬元，特別攜手LINE Bank合作即日起開放預購、申購服務，希望提供更創新、便利的申購流程，減輕投資人參與ETF IPO難度。該基金預定每季配息（預定為3、6、9、12月），設有收益平準金機制，經理費用每年0.80%，保管費用每年0.04%，風險報酬等級為RR5。
paras_en: Recent volatility in Taiwan stocks has intensified, but market swings have not shaken investors' confidence in the long‑term AI trend. With AI now a core investment theme, the bigger question is what to position next to keep pace with rapid rotations and stay at the forefront of the trend. Schroders Investment Trust believes that as AI opportunities spread from large‑cap stocks to more parts of the value chain, market rotation increases, and active management can better deliver stock‑selection and flexible adjustment value. Its first active Taiwan‑stock ETF, the Schroders AI Technology Taiwan Active ETF (00419A‑TW), is slated to raise capital from Nov 2‑6, with each unit priced at NT$10 and a minimum subscription of NT$10,000, and it is opening pre‑orders now in partnership with LINE Bank.

Schroders' Taiwan equity team analysis shows AI is reshaping the Asian market map, with Taiwan and South Korea riding the AI wave to surpass China and become the two largest weightings in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index. Meanwhile, both markets have high concentration, with large‑cap stocks carrying a larger share of index weight.

Looking at industry structure, the investment logic for AI benefits differs between Taiwan and South Korea. The Schroders Taiwan team says Korean AI opportunities currently focus on scarcity arising from supply‑demand imbalances, while Taiwan emphasizes "specification upgrades" driven by technological iteration. As AI computing power keeps rising, Taiwan’s semiconductor, PCB, thermal management, high‑speed transmission, power and infrastructure segments continuously upgrade, extending AI investment opportunities along the value chain.

Fundamentals also provide support. Schroders data shows Taiwan's August export value rose from $75.3 billion to $82.4 billion, a record monthly high, with strong demand for advanced chips, AI servers and key components. Market forecasts for 2026 corporate earnings have been revised upward for 15 consecutive months, with AI demand a key driver. As AI opportunities shift to different industry segments with higher specs, the key is not only to grasp the overall AI direction but also to identify the next companies benefiting from tech upgrades and profit growth, giving active research, stock‑picking and dynamic rebalancing greater scope.

As AI expands from semiconductors to components, infrastructure and new applications, the investment landscape becomes more diverse. The Schroders Taiwan team expects opportunities across AI semiconductors, AI devices, AI infrastructure and emerging AI fields. Schroders has long cultivated active Taiwan equity investing, including products like the Schroders Taiwan Happy Small‑Cap Fund; this launch of the first active Taiwan‑stock ETF 00419A focuses on the AI theme, leveraging the team’s fundamental research and active stock‑selection to flexibly capture growth amid industry rotation.

The fund’s investment process starts with a pool of over 1,800 Taiwan stocks, filters for quality, then integrates the AI theme, evaluating industry trends, AI value‑chain positioning and corporate competitiveness. Active management adds value not just by "picking stocks" but by knowing where opportunities are moving and aligning the investment layout accordingly.

00419A will raise capital from Nov 2‑6, with each unit priced at NT$10 and a minimum subscription of NT$10,000. In partnership with LINE Bank, pre‑orders and subscription services are open now, aiming to provide a more innovative and convenient subscription process and lower the difficulty for investors to participate in an ETF IPO. The fund plans quarterly distributions (March, June, September, December), includes a yield‑smoothing mechanism, charges a 0.80% annual management fee and a 0.04% custodial fee, and carries a risk‑return rating of RR5.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉AI需求旺盛磷化銦缺口短期難解 聯亞飆漲半根停板
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Strong AI Demand Leaves a Short‑Term Indium Phosphide Gap, Lian Ya Soars Half‑Board Halt
paras: 隨著AI伺服器帶動800G、1.6T高速光模組需求持續旺盛，三五族磊晶製造廠聯亞(3081-TW)上周雖遭外資連4賣，今(27)日仍開高走高，盤中在大單敲進下，一度飆漲9.47%，股價觸及2,600元。法人表示，在光通訊與CPO(共同封裝)技術發展帶動下，上游關鍵原料磷化銦(InP)基板供不應求，預期隨供需缺口延續，成長動能可望持續增溫。
業界指出，包括全新(2455-TW)、聯亞等磷化銦為主的光通訊廠，因磷化銦缺料問題仍在，不僅產能遠遠跟不上訂單，磷化銦基板、磊晶價格也不斷上揚，粗估磷化銦基板與磊晶缺口目前仍高達三成以上。
聯亞今(2026)年前3季合併營收達36.87億元、年增136.33%。聯亞先前在法說上表示，公司仍受矽光產品持續增加出貨增加挹注業績增長，目前1.6T產品已開始量產，3.2T也持續與客戶協商開發中，
受惠於光通訊需求噴發，聯亞在產線上持續進行擴產準備，今年8月底經聯亞董事會決議，通過不超過新台幣22.7億元的設備投資案，加上聯亞與美、日供應商，簽訂長期的磷化銦(InP)基板採購合約，也建立穩定的料件需求，以滿足客戶的強勁需求。
全新則表示，受惠於AIDC(AI資料中心)需求仍爆發性成長，目前在出貨上遇到磷化銦基板、磊晶都供不應求，目前「訂單需求不大，主要在缺料可以生產出貨給客戶」問題較大。
外資則表示，磷化銦基板及CW Laser等雷射光源，仍為光通訊產業需求重中之重，若基板供應量增加或增加良率，整體產業鏈有望進一步紓解供貨壓力。
paras_en: As AI servers continue to drive robust demand for 800 Gb and 1.6 Tb high‑speed optical modules, Lian Ya (3081‑TW), a wafer‑fab for III‑V epitaxial crystals, was sold off by foreign investors four times last week but still opened higher and rose during trading on the 27th, spiking 9.47% at one point and reaching a price of NT$2,600. Institutional investors said that, propelled by developments in optical communications and CPO (co‑packaged optics) technology, upstream key material indium phosphide (InP) substrates are in short supply, and the ongoing supply‑demand gap is expected to keep growth momentum heating up.

Industry sources note that optical‑communication manufacturers that rely on InP, such as Quanzhen (2455‑TW) and Lian Ya, are still facing material shortages; capacity lags far behind orders, and the prices of InP substrates and epitaxial wafers keep climbing. Rough estimates put the shortage of InP substrates and epitaxial wafers at more than 30 % at present.

Lian Ya reported combined revenue of NT$3.687 billion for the first three quarters of 2026, a year‑over‑year increase of 136.33 %. The company previously said in its earnings briefing that continued shipments of silicon‑photonic products are boosting earnings, that 1.6 Tb products have already entered mass production, and that 3.2 Tb products are under ongoing development negotiations with customers.

Benefiting from the surge in optical‑communication demand, Lian Ya is preparing to expand its production lines. At the end of August this year, the board approved an equipment‑investment plan of up to NT$2.27 billion. In addition, Lian Ya has signed long‑term procurement contracts for InP substrates with U.S. and Japanese suppliers, establishing a stable material supply to meet strong customer demand.

Quanzhen said that, thanks to explosive growth in AI data‑center (AIDC) demand, it is also facing a shortage of InP substrates and epitaxial wafers, with shipments constrained by lack of material. The company highlighted that the main issue is “order demand is not the problem; the lack of material prevents us from producing and shipping to customers.”

Foreign investors added that InP substrates and CW lasers remain critical components for the optical‑communication industry. If substrate supply or yields increase, the overall supply chain could see further relief of the current supply pressure.

items.title: 新穎生醫檢測產品取得關鍵自費碼 跨足中大型醫院
items.title_en: Innovative Biomedical Testing Product Secures Key Self-Pay Code, Expands into Mid‑to‑Large Hospitals
paras: 新穎生醫(6810-TW)宣布，旗下自主開發的精準腎功能檢測產品「遠腎佳DNlite」已正式取得區域醫院級以上醫療機構的自費檢測收費項目核准(自費碼)。新穎生醫指出，此一進展為導入臨床檢測服務奠定商業化收費基礎，也從目前基層診所與健檢中心，進一步跨足中大型醫療院所。
新穎生醫指出，在國內醫療法規下，創新醫療技術與檢測項目若要從臨床試驗走向大規模及應用，取得地方衛生局核發的醫療機構自費碼是不可或缺的。
董事長曾錙翎表示，此次取得自費碼，除大幅提升醫療院所導入自費檢測服務的可行性，也為後續全國院所合作、臨床檢測流程建置及市場接受度創造有利的商業條件。
隨著自費碼陸續落定，新穎生醫的營銷通路迎來躍升，從過去以預防醫學、基層診所及初階健檢為主的市場驗證階段，正式推進至區域醫院專科門診、各大醫學中心與高階健檢體系等核心醫療場域，有助產品市場滲透率與客單價值提升。
在基層醫療與健康管理通路布局方面，截至今年第三季，DNlite的合作簽約機構數已較2025年底大幅成長超過6成，顯示公司同步深耕基層醫療與預防醫學市場，預料通路拓展效益將逐步發酵。
新穎生醫表示，未來將以既有合作院所為基礎，加速推進檢測服務的臨床應用與深度導入，建立可複製且預期的穩定商業模式。隨著醫療院所自費碼陸續到位與基層通路網雙軌並進，對未來2年營運審慎樂觀。
paras_en: Innovative Biomedical (6810‑TW) announced that its independently developed precise kidney function test product “YuanShenJia DNlite” has officially obtained self‑pay code approval for regional hospitals and larger medical institutions. The company said this milestone lays a commercial billing foundation for clinical testing services and moves the product beyond primary clinics and health‑check centers into mid‑to‑large hospitals.

Innovative Biomedical noted that under domestic medical regulations, innovative medical technologies and test items must obtain self‑pay codes issued by local health bureaus to transition from clinical trials to large‑scale application.

Chairperson Zeng Ziling stated that securing the self‑pay code greatly enhances the feasibility of hospitals adopting self‑pay testing services and creates favorable commercial conditions for nationwide hospital collaborations, clinical testing workflow establishment, and market acceptance.

As self‑pay codes are finalized, Innovative Biomedical’s marketing channels are set to surge, moving from a validation phase focused on preventive medicine, primary clinics and basic health checks to core medical settings such as regional hospital specialty clinics, major medical centers and high‑end health‑check systems, boosting market penetration and average transaction value.

Regarding its primary care and health‑management channel rollout, by the third quarter of this year the number of institutions partnering with DNlite had grown more than 60% compared with the end of 2025, indicating the company’s continued deepening in primary care and preventive medicine markets and suggesting that channel expansion benefits will gradually materialize.

Innovative Biomedical said it will build on existing partner institutions to accelerate clinical application and deeper integration of the testing service, establishing a replicable and stable business model. With self‑pay codes increasingly in place and a dual‑track expansion of primary‑care channels, the company is cautiously optimistic about its operations over the next two years.

items.title: 宏達電正式揭曉VIVEE擴大個人AI產品布局 AI帶進穿搭、陪伴與互動打造新世代日常
items.title_en: HTC Unveils VIVEE, Expanding Its Personal AI Product Line into Fashion, Companionship, and Interaction for a New Generation of Daily Life
paras: VR軟硬體整合商宏達電(2498-TW)今（27）日正式揭曉全新個人AI產品 VIVEE。VIVEE創新結合AI對話、長期記憶、個性養成與實體互動，將AI體驗延伸至可隨身攜帶、持續互動的個人陪伴裝置。隨著日常對話與共同經歷的累積，VIVEE能逐步形塑出獨特的個性回應方式，拓展個人AI產品在日常陪伴與個人化互動上的新應用。
VIVEE全球市場布局同步展開，目前已於美國開放預購，後續亦規劃拓展至台灣、日本及歐洲等市場；台灣及日本市場亦預計於今年底前陸續上市，各地區相關銷售資訊將於後續公布。
VIVEE採小巧圓潤設計，大小約如雞蛋，可放置於桌面，也能掛在包包上隨身攜帶。透過生動的螢幕表情、語音對話，以及觸碰、搖晃與轉動等實體互動，VIVEE自然加入不同生活片刻，成為能陪伴聊天、互動，也能展現個人風格的日常AI玩伴。
HTC董事長暨執行長王雪紅表示：「VIVEE 的誕生結合了想像力、科技與一點科幻色彩，也代表我們對個人AI產品更多可能性的探索。我們看到消費者愈來愈重視科技是否能展現個人風格、回應生活情境，甚至成為人與人之間新的互動媒介。我們希望透過VIVEE，讓AI 以更自然、富有表現力的方式融入生活，為日常科技帶來兼具獨特個性與新鮮感的互動體驗。」
VIVEE的角色故事從一群由純粹能量構成、對人類生活充滿好奇的小生命開始，因為想了解『成為人類是什麼感覺』而來到地球。第一次啟用時，使用者並不會事先知道會遇到什麼個性的VIVEE；可能是活潑好奇、冷靜可靠、直接自信、柔軟敏感、理性怪趣或溫暖體貼等個性，讓初次相遇都多了一份未知與期待。
真正的個性，也從第一次「Hello」之後逐步展開。每一次聊天、互動與共同經歷，都可能成為VIVEE個性的一部分；即使從相同的個性起點開始，也可能因為不同的相處歷程，逐漸形塑出不同的反應與互動方式。面對同一個問題，不同個性的VIVEE也可能展現截然不同的回應。
面對相同問題，不同個性的VIVEE也可能展現不同的回應方式。
VIVEE以陪伴與互動體驗為核心，能成為分享日常與心情的玩伴，不論是聊聊今天想做什麼、一起激發靈感，或是使用內建的拍貼機（Photobooth）功能，留下與 VIVEE 的有趣互動，都讓 AI 自然加入生活中的大小片刻。
互動也不只停留在語音對話，觸碰如摸摸、拍拍、搖晃或轉動VIVEE，都可能觸發不同的表情與回應；隨著彼此熟悉程度增加，更多玩法也會逐步解鎖。
未來，VIVEE亦將進一步解鎖「多機互動」功能，讓不同VIVEE之間產生交流，將個人陪伴延伸至朋友間的社交與共享情境。
VIVEE帶來的不只是另一項科技新品，也是一種新的生活風格型態。
VIVEE提供多款配色與VIVEE Suits造型配件，使用者可依照穿搭、場合與個人喜好自由搭配。VIVEE Suits內建NFC技術，換上不同造型後亦可解鎖相對應的螢幕表情，讓個人風格從穿搭延伸至VIVEE的表情與互動。無論放在桌邊或隨身搭配，VIVEE不只是個人AI產品，也成為展現個人風格的一部分，讓每日穿搭多了一種可以被看見的「表情」。
VIVEE Suits 造型配件，內建 NFC 技術，能解鎖 VIVEE 不同的螢幕UI表情！
VIVEE從設計之初即將隱私納入重要考量，其核心功能無須連結使用者的電子郵件、社群媒體、銀行帳戶或其他個人帳號。VIVEE採用無相機設計、並配置可實體靜音開關，可隨時關閉麥克風與喇叭。
在AI功能方面，HTC亦導入相關隱私與安全保護機制，包括在資訊分享予第三方AI服務供應商前採取去識別化措施；使用者與VIVEE的互動內容亦不會被用於訓練通用型大型語言模型。
VIVEE推出宇宙黑、星空銀、珍珠白、幸運金與寶石紅五款亮眼配色，另推出野性叢林、冥想樹洞與繽紛海洋三款 VIVEE Suits 造型配件，不僅提供外型配搭與保護功能，亦可解鎖更多表情，讓VIVEE從隨身裝置進一步成為個人穿搭與風格的一部分。
paras_en: HTC (2498‑TW), a VR hardware‑software integrator, officially unveiled its new personal AI product VIVEE today (27th). VIVEE uniquely blends AI conversation, long‑term memory, personality development and physical interaction, extending the AI experience to a portable, continuously interactive personal companion device. As everyday dialogues and shared experiences accumulate, VIVEE gradually shapes a distinctive personality response style, opening new applications for personal AI in daily companionship and personalized interaction.

The global rollout of VIVEE is underway; pre‑orders are already open in the United States, with plans to expand to Taiwan, Japan and Europe. The Taiwan and Japan markets are expected to launch before the end of the year, with sales details for each region to be announced later.

VIVEE features a compact, rounded design roughly the size of an egg, suitable for placement on a desk or hanging from a bag for on‑the‑go use. Through lively screen expressions, voice dialogue, and tactile interactions such as touching, shaking and rotating, VIVEE naturally integrates into various moments of life, becoming a daily AI playmate that can chat, interact and showcase personal style.

HTC Chairperson and CEO Cher Wang said: “The birth of VIVEE combines imagination, technology and a touch of sci‑fi, representing our exploration of more possibilities for personal AI products. We see consumers increasingly caring about whether technology can express personal style, respond to life situations, and even become a new medium for human‑to‑human interaction. We hope VIVEE lets AI blend into life in a more natural, expressive way, delivering an interaction experience that is both uniquely personal and fresh.”

VIVEE’s character story begins with a group of tiny life‑forms made of pure energy, curious about human life and arriving on Earth to learn what it feels like to be human. When first activated, users won’t know which personality VIVEE will have—perhaps lively and curious, calm and reliable, bold and confident, soft and sensitive, rationally quirky, or warm and caring—adding an element of mystery and anticipation to the first encounter.

True personality unfolds after the first “Hello.” Every chat, interaction and shared experience can become part of VIVEE’s character; even starting from the same personality seed, different interaction histories can shape distinct reactions and interaction styles. Faced with the same question, VIVEEs of different personalities may give completely different answers.
When faced with the same question, VIVEEs of different personalities may exhibit different response styles.

VIVEE centers on companionship and interactive experience, serving as a playmate for sharing daily moments and moods—whether discussing plans for the day, sparking inspiration together, or using the built‑in Photobooth feature to capture fun interactions, AI naturally becomes part of life’s big and small moments.
Interaction goes beyond voice; touching, patting, shaking or rotating VIVEE can trigger varied expressions and replies, and as familiarity grows, more play modes will gradually unlock.

In the future, VIVEE will further unlock a “multi‑device interaction” feature, allowing different VIVEE units to communicate, extending personal companionship into social and shared scenarios among friends.
VIVEE brings not just another tech gadget but a new lifestyle paradigm.

VIVEE offers multiple colors and VIVEE Suits accessories; users can mix and match according to outfits, occasions and personal preferences. VIVEE Suits embed NFC technology, so changing the suit unlocks corresponding screen expressions, extending personal style from clothing to VIVEE’s facial expressions and interactions. Whether on a desk or carried around, VIVEE becomes more than a personal AI product—it’s part of expressing individual style, adding a visible “expression” to daily outfits.
VIVEE Suits accessories contain built‑in NFC that can unlock different screen UI expressions on VIVEE!

From the design stage, VIVEE prioritized privacy; its core functions do not require linking to the user’s email, social media, bank accounts or other personal accounts. VIVEE uses a camera‑free design and includes a physical mute switch to turn off the microphone and speaker at any time.

Regarding AI functions, HTC has incorporated privacy and security safeguards, including de‑identification before sharing information with third‑party AI service providers; user‑VIVEE interaction content will not be used to train generic large language models.

VIVEE launches in five striking colors—cosmic black, starry silver, pearl white, lucky gold and gemstone red—and three VIVEE Suits styles—wild jungle, meditation cave and vibrant ocean. The accessories not only provide aesthetic and protective functions but also unlock additional expressions, turning VIVEE from a portable device into an integral part of personal fashion and style.
