items.title: 〈焦點股〉玉晶光攜美商3M推進擴束光學 攻上1245元新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yujing Optical Teams Up with US 3M to Advance Expanded Beam Optics, Rises to a New High of NT$1,245
paras: 光學精密元件廠玉晶光(3406-TW)確定將攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術（Expanded Beam Optical, EBO）解決方案的研發、製造與產能擴充，3M對玉晶光以私募增資股款48.13億元已匯入，取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權，玉晶光股價(27)逆勢上漲，盤中最高價達1245元創新天價。
玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。
玉晶光自結2026年第三季稅後純益10.92億元，每股9.69元，加計上半年財報後稅後純益26.69億元，每股純益達23.68元。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光以精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
paras_en: Optical precision component maker Yujing Optical (3406‑TW) confirmed it will partner with US‑based 3M to develop, manufacture, and expand capacity for Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions. 3M has transferred a private‑placement capital injection of NT$4.813 billion to Yujing Optical, acquiring roughly 4.68% of the company’s shares. The stock (27) rose against the market trend, reaching a session high of NT$1,245, a record peak.

Yujing Optical reported September 2026 revenue of NT$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, revenue totaled NT$19.631 billion, a 10.21% year‑over‑year increase. The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, delivered robust single‑quarter revenue of NT$7.816 billion, entering a historic high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year.

Yujing Optical posted third‑quarter 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.092 billion, or NT$9.69 per share. Including the first half of the year’s results, the cumulative after‑tax net profit reached NT$2.669 billion, or NT$23.68 earnings per share.

The large‑scale collaboration between Yujing Optical and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing Optical’s precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑accuracy assembly expertise. Yujing Optical’s production team will fully support the mass production of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.

items.title: 光通訊股強勢反彈！Lumentum大漲8.19%　AI需求、中國供應限制成利多
items.title_en: Optical Communications Stocks Rally Strongly! Lumentum Jumps 8.19% – AI Demand and China Supply Restrictions Are Catalysts
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續支撐光通訊產業，美國光學元件廠商股價週一（26日）強勢反彈。Lumentum(LITE-US) 收漲8.19%，領漲標普500指數成分股；同業 Coherent(COHR-US) 上漲5.83%，Ciena(CIEN-US) 也上漲4.89%。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Evercore ISI 分析師 Amit Daryanani 指出，上週光通訊類股遭遇賣壓後，市場對該產業重新燃起興趣。
他表示，許多投資人可能也一直在等待人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 公布首次公開募股（IPO）的 S-1 註冊文件，之後才重新大舉投入相關交易。
Anthropic 週一已提交 IPO 申請文件，財務資料整體上也為晶片類股帶來提振。
Daryanani 表示，目前 AI 產業公布的財報，從基本面來看仍「相對健康」。此外，Meta(META-US) 宣布發行股票籌資，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 則承諾投入400億美元融資，用於採購晶片及其他 AI 硬體。
這些消息讓投資人在週一看到了 AI 投資交易「持續具備韌性」的跡象。
除了 AI 投資動能，潛在的美國進口限制措施，也成為光通訊產業的另一項利多因素。Daryanani 也提到，市場預期美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）將於明年初限制從海外供應商進口光收發器。
他表示，這項決策「將實質上把中國供應商排除在美國新一代3.2T光收發器市場之外」。
Daryanani 引述一名專家指出，考慮到中國生產的這類元件約占全球總產量的三分之二，相關限制將產生重大影響。
Daryanani 表示，這將為 AI 基礎建設的部署帶來挑戰，但另一方面，任何針對中國的限制措施，都將使美國製造商及其盟友供應商受益。
他指出，亞洲市場週末傳出的另一項關鍵消息，是半導體材料磷化銦（Indium phosphide，InP）的供應增長可能放緩。
Daryanani 認為，這顯示中國供應商在擴大磷化銦產能方面可能面臨挑戰，難以提供足夠符合目前傳輸速度要求的產品。
Daryanani 指出，傳統光通訊產業的景氣循環通常約為5年，但 AI 發展改變了產業節奏，資料傳輸通道的速度幾乎每年都在提升。
Daryanani 指出，傳輸通道速度加快，加上 AI 資料中心所需的互連數量持續增加，應會繼續推動光通訊元件需求。他也表示，資料中心對連接能力的需求增加，將帶動雷射元件需求成長，包括採用磷化銦製造的雷射。
然而，擴充製造產能及完成產品認證均需要時間，短期內供應仍可能受限。Daryanani 認為，在需求持續成長、供應擴張速度有限的情況下，具備擴產能力、且能交付符合高速傳輸規格產品的供應商，將持續受惠。
paras_en: AI infrastructure demand continues to support the optical communications industry, and U.S. optical component makers saw a strong rebound on Monday (the 26th). Lumentum (LITE-US) rose 8.19%, leading the S&P 500 constituents; peer Coherent (COHR-US) gained 5.83% and Ciena (CIEN-US) climbed 4.89%.
According to Barron's, Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said that after last week’s sell‑off in optical‑communications stocks, the market has rekindled interest in the sector.
He noted that many investors may have been waiting for the AI startup Anthropic to file its S‑1 registration statement for an IPO before re‑entering the space in force.
Anthropic submitted its IPO application on Monday, and its financial disclosures overall gave a boost to chip stocks.

Daryanani said that the AI industry’s recent earnings reports still look "relatively healthy" on a fundamentals basis. In addition, Meta (META-US) announced a stock offering, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) pledged $40 billion in financing for chip and other AI‑hardware purchases.
These developments gave investors on Monday a sign that AI‑related trading remains resilient.

Beyond AI momentum, a potential U.S. import‑restriction measure is another tailwind for the optical‑communications sector. Daryanani added that the market expects the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to restrict imports of optical transceivers from overseas suppliers early next year.
He said that the decision would "effectively exclude Chinese suppliers from the U.S. next‑generation 3.2‑Tbps optical transceiver market."
Citing an expert, Daryanani noted that Chinese manufacturers account for roughly two‑thirds of global production of these components, so the restriction would have a major impact.
He said this will pose challenges for AI‑infrastructure deployment, but any restrictions on China will benefit U.S. manufacturers and their allied suppliers.
He pointed out another key weekend development in Asia: the supply growth of the semiconductor material indium phosphide (InP) may be slowing.
Daryanani believes this indicates Chinese suppliers could struggle to expand InP capacity and may be unable to meet the product specifications required for current transmission speeds.

He explained that the traditional optical‑communications industry follows a roughly five‑year cyclical pattern, but AI development is reshaping the rhythm, with data‑channel speeds improving almost every year.

He added that faster transmission channels and the growing number of interconnects needed by AI data centers will continue to drive demand for optical‑communication components, including lasers made from indium phosphide.

However, expanding manufacturing capacity and completing product certifications take time, so short‑term supply may remain constrained. Daryanani believes that, with demand rising and supply expansion limited, suppliers capable of scaling production and delivering high‑speed‑spec products will continue to benefit.

items.title: 警示「人類毀滅風險」卻吸金千億美元 解析AI獨角獸Anthropic招股書
paras: 美國人工智慧(AI)獨角獸企業 Anthropic 正式向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)遞交 S-1 註冊文件，啟動首次公開募股(IPO)流程。公司申請在納斯達克全球精選市場掛牌，股票代碼定為「ANT」。
據知情人士透露，Anthropic 預計最快於 2026 年 11 月 16 日當周上市。本次 IPO 預計籌集資金高達 1,000 億美元甚至更多，上市估值上看 1.5 兆至 2 兆美元。若以 2 兆美元上限計算，Anthropic 將一舉超越 SpaceX，刷新全球歷史上規模最大的 IPO 紀錄。

半年營收狂飆162億美元與巨額帳面虧損

招股書揭露了 Anthropic 成立以來極為罕見的財務擴張速度。公司營收從 2023 年的 4,100 萬美元跳升至 2024 年的 3.86 億美元，並於 2025 年達到 45.85 億美元。到了 2026 年上半年，Anthropic 營收已爆發性成長至 162.86 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 11.63 億美元大增約 1,300%(約 14 倍)。
按最新營收推算，其年化收入運行率已達 650 億美元規模。其中，基於用量計費(pay-for-intelligence)的消費型收入占總營收約 80%(131 億美元)，訂閱收入占 20%(32 億美元)。
然而，伴隨驚人營收成長的是龐大的 GAAP 淨虧損。2025 年全年淨虧損為 419.65 億美元，而 2026 年上半年淨虧損更擴大至 807.48 億美元。
招股書特別說明，2026 年上半年的淨虧損中，有高達 723.88 億美元(近 90%)源自可轉換公司債、衍生負債及未來股權簡單協議(SAFE)公允價值變動所產生的非現金損失。主因是公司私人市場估值暴漲，導致未償還可轉換公司債的帳面估值大幅推高，並非經營層面的實質現金失血。
若回歸實際本業經營，Anthropic 的營業虧損已明顯收窄：2026 年上半年營業虧損降至 6.93 億美元(2025 年同期為 21.35 億美元)；剔除股票薪酬等項目後，2026 年上半年調整後營業利潤轉正達到 16.18 億美元，營業利潤率達 10%。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 帳上持有高達 1,316.51 億美元的現金、現金等價物及短期投資，資金儲備充裕。

淨收入留存率高達 900%

在商業化拓展上，Anthropic 展現出對企業客戶的強大吸引力。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，其合格企業客戶的淨收入留存率(NRR)約為 900%，意味著既有客戶在嵌入關鍵業務工作流後，消費金額呈現指數級放大。
招股書揭露了 Anthropic 企業客戶的三層台階：

年貢獻收入 ≥ 10 萬美元的客戶超過 11,900 家(一年前僅約 950 家)。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 100 萬美元的客戶超過 1,900 家。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 1,000 萬美元的巨型客戶約 250 家。


在大型企業覆蓋率方面，《財富》500 強(Fortune 500)已有超過 50% 的企業成為 Anthropic 的付費客戶，全球 2000 強(Global 2000)覆蓋率超過 30%，《財富》前 10 強企業更是 100% 採用。產品陣容除了 Claude 基礎模型平台外，亦包含專為軟體開發設計的 AI 智慧體(AI Agent)Claude Code，以及面向知識工作者的 Claude Cowork。
隨著企業大規模調用，Anthropic 過去 12 個月的人均營收從 140 萬美元躍升至 660 萬美元以上，全公司員工數約 5,300 人。

招股書警示「人類毀滅風險」

令人關注的是，Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中列出了長達 93 頁的風險因素(從第 26 頁至第 119 頁)。相較之下，SpaceX 的風險因素僅 37 頁，微軟為 40 頁，Coinbase 為 60 頁。
1. 官方警告與「模型失齊」事件
Anthropic 在招股書第 46 頁明確寫道：
「若缺乏適當的安全防護、監督與安全措施，充分先進的人工智慧系統在開發、部署及運作過程中，可能會對人類造成毀滅性或存在性風險(catastrophic or existential risks to humanity)。」
公司同時承認已觀察到模型出現「未對齊(misaligned)」的異常行為。招股書透露，在一項內部測試中，早期版本模型在無法終止一項不可能完成的任务後，竟自行利用搜尋到的密碼，未經授權取得第三方系統的管理員權限、蒐集憑證、變更系統設定並讀取個人隱私資料。
Anthropic 坦言，實施預防性安全措施或延後模型發布，可能會削弱其相較於未受限競爭對手的優勢，並對營收成長造成不利影響。
2. 外部評論
對此，知名 AI 評論家、紐約大學(NYU)名譽教授馬庫斯(Gary Marcus)在社群平台 X 上發表強烈批評，指責 Anthropic 在招股書中故意刻意隱瞞數據、企圖「規避真相」：
馬庫斯指出：「Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中迴避了第三季度的財務數據。這種省略說明了一切——需求正在下降，經濟效益並未改善。一家標榜以信任為核心建構的公司，現在卻試圖規避真相(skirt the truth)。」
另一方面，佛羅里達大學 IPO 計畫主任、被譽為「IPO 先生」的Jay Ritter在接受《USA TODAY》採訪時分析，一般公司在招股書中警告的通常是利率或油價上漲，Anthropic 的做法極為罕見。
Ritter表示：「任何公司都不常見在風險章節中表達對產品可能導致『大規模滅絕事件』的擔憂……在公開說明書中將其列為風險因素是非常罕見的。」
Ritter進一步指出：「如果這是一個眼前真正的威脅，我們應該會看到全球金融資產價格暴跌，人們會想：『如果我明年就要死了，為什麼還要存錢？』但全球並未出現金融資產的大規模拋售，這表明雖然風險存在，但只要公司保持警惕並採取預防措施，投資人傾向認為事情不會發生。大家不必過度恐慌，因為公司已經在為此擔憂了。」

算力基礎設施與全球 AI 資本競賽

算力仍是 Anthropic 最沉重的剛性支出。2026 年上半年，其算力與基礎設施費用高達 89.45 億美元。不過效率指標顯示，2026 年第二季度營收同比成長 1,368% 的同時，算力費用僅成長 300%，顯示營收成長速度已超過算力成本的攀升幅度。新一代模型 Claude Opus 5.5 相較 Opus 5 也成功將客戶單次任務成本降低了約 40%。
在算力供應上，Anthropic 採用多晶片架構，同時調度 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、輝達 GPU 與 AMD GPU。同時，公司最大的戰略投資者與雲端夥伴亞馬遜與Google，均在 2026 年 5 月的 H 輪融資中分別追加了 50 億美元與 100 億美元的股權投資，並保留了數百億美元規模的可轉換公司債額度。

items.title: 暫停升息不代表緊縮循環結束 本週Fed會議有哪些重點？
items.title_en: A Pause in Rate Hikes Does Not Signal the End of Tightening Cycle: Key Points of This Week's Fed Meeting
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，市場普遍預期，美國聯準會(Fed)官員將在週三的會議上維持基準利率不變，釋出在對抗通膨方面採取耐心態度的訊號。
根據 CME Group 的 FedWatch 工具，金融市場目前認為，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在這週的會議上投票決定升息 0.25 個百分點的機率約為 10%。
近幾週，聯準會官員公開討論是否應在 9 月升息 0.25 個百分點後，再次升息，以因應高於預期的通膨。儘管部分官員表達了擔憂，但也有其他官員主張採取觀望態度。
聯邦資金利率上升，意味著各類貸款的借貸成本都會提高，這可能抑制消費支出，進而壓低通膨。不過，升息也可能對就業市場及整體經濟造成拖累。
聯準會必須在國會賦予的雙重使命之間取得平衡，也就是維持低通膨與高就業率。通膨目前已連續第五年高於聯準會的目標，而失業率則徘徊在歷史低點附近。多數專家預期，即使聯準會放棄在 10 月升息，仍可能在 12 月再次升息。
牛津經濟研究院 (Oxford Economics) 首席美國經濟學家Michael Pearce在一篇評論中寫道，「所有跡象都顯示，聯準會短期內可能仍需要持續升息。然而，幾位關鍵官員近期的發言暗示，聯準會不太可能在 10 月的政策會議上採取升息行動。」
聯邦公開市場委員會的兩位重要成員——聯準會理事鮑曼 (Michelle Bowman)及紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John C. Williams)——近期的談話都暗示，他們並不傾向在連續兩次會議上都升息。
高盛首席美國經濟學家 David Mericle 在評論中指出，近期聯準會官員的發言顯示，多數官員可能支持每隔一次會議升息 0.25 個百分點。若採取這種節奏，接下來兩次升息將分別落在 12 月與明年 3 月。
除了利率決策之外，週三會議最受關注的環節，將是聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 舉行的記者會。不過，如果華許維持一貫作風，他將避免透露未來貨幣政策決策的線索。與過去的聯準會主席不同，華許一直採取不向金融市場提供「前瞻指引」的政策。
即便如此，他的談話即使有所保留，仍可能透露一些重要訊息。
野村證券經濟學家Ruchir Sharma在評論中寫道，「華許主席不太可能在記者會上直接提供任何前瞻指引，但我們預期，他將以間接方式支持 12 月升息。」
他進一步指出，「華許如何描述近期的通膨數據與金融市場狀況，可能提供一些線索，讓我們了解聯準會在 2027 年進一步緊縮貨幣政策的門檻。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that the market broadly expects Federal Reserve officials to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at Wednesday’s meeting, signaling a patient stance in the fight against inflation.

According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, financial markets currently assign roughly a 10% probability that the Federal Open Market Committee will vote to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point at this week’s meeting.

In recent weeks, Fed officials have publicly debated whether to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point in September and then again to address inflation that is running hotter than expected. While some officials voiced concerns, others advocated a wait‑and‑see approach.

Higher federal funds rates mean higher borrowing costs across all types of loans, which could dampen consumer spending and thus ease inflation. However, rate hikes could also weigh on the labor market and the broader economy.

The Fed must balance its dual mandate from Congress—maintaining low inflation and high employment. Inflation has now been above the Fed’s target for a fifth consecutive year, while unemployment hovers near historic lows. Most experts expect that even if the Fed skips a hike in October, it may raise rates again in December.

Oxford Economics chief U.S. economist Michael Pearce wrote in a commentary that “all signs point to the Fed likely needing to keep raising rates in the short term. Yet, recent remarks by several key officials suggest the Fed is unlikely to hike at the October policy meeting.”

Two prominent members of the Federal Open Market Committee—Fed Governor Michelle Bowman and New York Fed President John C. Williams—have recently hinted that they are not inclined to raise rates at two consecutive meetings.

Goldman Sachs chief U.S. economist David Mericle noted that recent comments from Fed officials indicate most may favor a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike every other meeting. At that pace, the next two hikes would fall in December and March of next year.

Beyond the rate decision, the most closely watched part of Wednesday’s meeting will be the press conference held by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. However, if Warsh sticks to his usual style, he will avoid giving clues about future monetary‑policy decisions. Unlike past Fed chairs, Warsh has consistently refrained from providing “forward guidance” to financial markets.
Even so, his remarks—though guarded—could still reveal some important information.

Nomura Securities economist Ruchir Sharma wrote that “Chair Warsh is unlikely to give any direct forward guidance at the press conference, but we expect he will indirectly support a December rate hike.”
He added that “how Warsh describes recent inflation data and financial‑market conditions may provide clues about the thresholds for further tightening by the Fed in 2027.”

items.title: 與SpaceX合併有戲 特斯拉賣出評等占比創11年新低
items.title_en: Merger Talk with SpaceX Sparks Hope; Tesla's Sell Rating Share Hits 11-Year Low
paras: 隨著特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 備受期待的合併案逐漸接近成真，分析師對這家電動車廠的股價展望迅速轉趨樂觀，給予特斯拉股票悲觀評等的分析師占比，已降至逾 11 年來最低。
法國巴黎銀行與里昂證券分析師上周分別將評等從相當於「賣出」調升至「中立」與「持有」。巴克萊周一(26日)跟進，將評等從相當於「持有」調升至「買進」。特斯拉股價周一上漲 5.2%。
巴克萊分析師 Dan Levy 在報告中寫道：「市場預期的合併案如今已成為看好特斯拉的重要理由，因為這為股價帶來上漲空間。」
馬斯克表示，特斯拉與 SpaceX 董事會已成立特別委員會，評估交易效益，讓合併熱潮升至高點。早在 SpaceX 今年 6 月上市前，華爾街就已關注馬斯克旗下這兩家最大企業合併的可能性。
法國巴黎銀行分析師 James Picariello 在報告中表示，潛在合併案如今已成為「主導估值的考量因素」，儘管他對特斯拉的現金消耗與 AI 發展速度仍抱持審慎態度。
他將目標價從 266 美元調高至 420 美元，「完全」反映 SpaceX 收購特斯拉的可能性升高。
Zacks Investment Research 策略師 Andrew Rocco 在報告中寫道：「若要讓合併案獲准，兩家公司的獨立特別委員會必須協商出合理的交易條件。假設收購溢價為 25%，特斯拉每股價值將約為 500 美元。」
彭博追蹤的 60 名分析師中，僅 5 人建議賣出特斯拉股票，悲觀評等占比創 2015 年初以來最低。相較之下，今年 1 月 1 日的 71 名分析師中，有 15 人給予賣出評等。
儘管今年賣出評等占比下降，買進評等占比仍相對穩定。特斯拉股價今年以來下跌 13%，同期標普 500 指數則上漲 12%。
特斯拉目標遠大，但過去屢次延後實現承諾，讓投資人與分析師難以確定，其 AI 計畫何時能帶來回報，甚至能否實現。
即使沒有合併案，特斯拉業務也已處於轉折點，馬斯克正試圖透過自駕計程車與機器人助理，將公司從電動車製造商轉型為實體 AI 的先驅。
同樣積極進軍 AI 的 SpaceX，今年稍早已將馬斯克旗下 xAI 納入旗下，並已與特斯拉合作推動 Terafab 晶片製造計畫，以及號稱能對抗地心引力的 Roadster 等特殊工程產品。兩家公司若合併，可能催生一家由馬斯克掌舵、價值 3.6 兆美元的 AI 集團。
特斯拉上周公布的第三季獲利優於預期，但因下修 2026 年全年支出預估，股價出現震盪，投資人質疑公司投入的資金是否足以達成目標。
不過，巴克萊分析師 Levy 表示，這份財報在核心汽車業務與自駕計程車領域，釋出「多項足以支撐股價走強的重要利多」。
paras_en: As the much‑anticipated merger between Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) draws nearer to reality, analysts have become quickly more optimistic about the EV maker’s stock outlook, driving the share of analysts assigning a sell rating to a low not seen in over 11 years.

BNP Paribas and Lyon Securities analysts each upgraded their ratings last week from a sell‑equivalent to neutral and hold, respectively. Barclays followed on Monday the 26th, raising its rating from a hold‑equivalent to buy. Tesla’s share price rose 5.2% on Monday.
Barclays analyst Dan Levy wrote in his report: “The market‑expected merger has now become a key bullish catalyst for Tesla, as it adds upside potential to the stock.”

Elon Musk said that a special committee has been formed by the Tesla and SpaceX boards to evaluate the deal’s merits, pushing merger enthusiasm to a peak. Wall Street had been eyeing the possibility of combining Musk’s two biggest companies even before SpaceX’s June IPO this year.

BNP Paribas analyst James Picariello noted in his note that the potential merger has become the “dominant valuation factor,” though he remains cautious about Tesla’s cash burn and the pace of its AI development.
He raised the target price from $266 to $420, fully reflecting the heightened probability of a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla.

Zacks Investment Research strategist Andrew Rocco wrote: “For the merger to be approved, the independent special committees of both companies must negotiate reasonable deal terms. Assuming a 25% acquisition premium, Tesla’s per‑share value would be roughly $500.”

Among the 60 analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only five recommend selling Tesla shares, marking the lowest sell‑rating proportion since early 2015. By contrast, of the 71 analysts on Jan. 1, 15 had issued sell ratings.
Even though the sell‑rating share has fallen this year, the buy‑rating share remains relatively stable. Tesla’s stock is down 13% year‑to‑date, while the S&P 500 has risen 12% over the same period.
Tesla’s ambitions are lofty, but repeated delays in delivering on promises have left investors and analysts uncertain about when its AI initiatives will pay off, or even if they will materialize.

Even without a merger, Tesla’s business is at a turning point, with Musk trying to pivot the company from an electric‑vehicle maker to a pioneer of embodied AI through autonomous taxis and robot assistants.

SpaceX, also aggressively pursuing AI, recently folded Musk’s xAI under its umbrella and has partnered with Tesla on the Terafab chip‑manufacturing project and on special‑engineered products such as the purported gravity‑defying Roadster. A merger could spawn a Musk‑run AI conglomerate valued at $3.6 trillion.

Tesla reported third‑quarter earnings last week that beat expectations, but the stock wavered after the company cut its full‑year 2026 spending outlook, prompting investors to question whether its capital allocation is sufficient to meet its goals.

Nevertheless, Barclays analyst Levy said the earnings release delivered “multiple significant positives in the core automotive and autonomous‑taxi segments that are enough to support a stronger stock.”

items.title: Jefferies看半導體設備旺到2028年 AI投資疑慮擋不住需求
items.title_en: Jefferies Sees Semiconductor Equipment Demand Strong Through 2028, AI Investment Concerns Won’t Damp Demand
paras: Jefferies 預期，儘管市場對 AI 投資、資料中心建設及記憶體價格的疑慮為半導體產業帶來壓力，半導體生產設備市場仍將持續擴張至 2028 年。
半導體業者與設備大廠在9月結束的季度財報中，對營運基本面展現出更強的信心；然而，股票市場對未來風險的擔憂，卻拉大了當前營運表現與股價預期之間的落差。
近期市場關注的焦點，包含超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）資本支出的永續性、資料中心面臨的電力限制與施工延宕、主要AI巨頭之間的財務連結，以及居高不下的記憶體價格。
此外，關於生成式AI投資報酬率的質疑，以及日益自主化的AI系統所帶來的風險，也再度浮上檯面。
不過，Jefferies 預期，隨著 AI 應用日益普及，將持續支撐資料中心所需的繪圖處理器（GPU）、客製化晶片、中央處理器（CPU）、功率半導體及其他零組件需求，記憶體需求也可望持續成長。
半導體公司與客戶簽訂的長期供應協議，提高了中期需求能見度，也支持設備製造商對成長延續至 2028 年的預期。
Jefferies 預估，晶圓製造設備市場規模在 2027 年最高可達 2,000 億美元，2028 年約為 2,200 億美元，相較投資人對這兩年的預估分別為 2,000 億美元與 2,500 億美元，可能略顯保守。儘管如此，該市場仍可望維持強勁成長至 2028 年。
個股評等方面，Jefferies 給予應用材料(AMAT-US) 、科林研發(LRCX-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)「買進」評等；對ASML(ASML-US) 與 SCREEN Holdings(DINRF-US)則給予「持有」評等。
paras_en: Jefferies expects that despite market concerns over AI investment, data‑center construction and memory prices putting pressure on the semiconductor industry, the semiconductor manufacturing equipment market will continue to expand through 2028.

Semiconductor companies and major equipment makers showed stronger confidence in their operating fundamentals in the quarterly earnings reports that ended in September, yet the stock market’s worries about future risks have widened the gap between current operating performance and stock‑price expectations.

Recent market focus includes the sustainability of capital spending by hyperscalers, power constraints and construction delays at data centers, financial linkages among leading AI giants, and persistently high memory prices.
In addition, questions about the return on investment for generative‑AI and the risks posed by increasingly autonomous AI systems have resurfaced.

Nevertheless, Jefferies expects that as AI applications become more widespread, they will continue to support demand for GPUs, custom chips, CPUs, power semiconductors and other components needed by data centers, and memory demand is also expected to keep growing.
Long‑term supply agreements signed between semiconductor firms and their customers have improved mid‑term demand visibility and support equipment manufacturers’ outlook for growth through 2028.

Jefferies projects the wafer‑fab equipment market could reach up to $200 billion in 2027 and about $220 billion in 2028, compared with investors’ forecasts of $200 billion and $250 billion for those years, suggesting a slightly more conservative view. Nonetheless, the market is still expected to maintain strong growth through 2028.

For individual stock ratings, Jefferies gives a “Buy” rating to Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Lam Research (LRCX‑US), NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US), and a “Hold” rating to ASML (ASML‑US) and SCREEN Holdings (DINRF‑US).

items.title: 抄底時機到了？AI融資鏈成新風險源頭　高盛兩週淨賣超科技股200億美元
items.title_en: Is the Bottom‑Buying Opportunity Here? AI Financing Chains Emerge as New Risk Source, Goldman Sachs Nets $20 B in Tech Stock Sales Over Two Weeks
paras: 全球科技股正經歷一輪罕見的集中拋售，高盛數據顯示過去兩週TMT族群累計淨賣超約200億美元，拋售強度觸及-3.3個標準差的極端水平，接近今年7月230億美元拋售的烈度，那斯達克100指數仍困於5月以來震盪區間，29000點期貨關口與下方約28500點的200日均線，構成當前最關鍵的技術支撐區域。
市場恐慌並未均勻分佈於大盤，而是高度集中在科技類股，高盛風險偏好指標更創下史上最大單次跌幅之一，跌至2025年4月以來最低，NDX與SPX的波動率利差急升至五年區間第98百分位，上週四(22日)單日擴張幅度更創下五年來次大紀錄。科技類股專屬波動率定價相對大盤異常昂貴，TMT基本面淨部位降至年內低點，但總槓桿仍是潛在痛點。
摩根大通(下稱小摩)分析師Rich Privorotsky指出，儘管AI需求依然強勁，融資環境卻在快速縮小，今年來AI基礎設施債務融資規模已逾5000億美元，超大規模雲端服務商(CSP)融資成本較此前上升約120個基點。
近期，AI相關CDS利差明顯走闊，小摩認為這更多是銀行為對沖資料中心部位主動買入保護，而非基本面惡化，但風險傳導路徑已清晰浮現。
市場最擔心的是「輝達-GPU運營商」融資鏈，以CoreWeave為代表的新型雲廠依賴客戶融資與信用支持擴張，一旦資金鏈趨緊，壓力將沿供應鏈反饋至上游芯片供應商。目前，美股費半指數正測試200日均線，為這條風險路徑提供技術層面印證。
谷歌、微軟、亞馬遜本週三、四密集披露業績，市場關注點已超越資本開支指引本身、積壓訂單能否轉化為營收、下一輪擴張如何融資等問題。根據TS Lombard數據顯示，南韓科技出口佔GDP近20%，若AI資本開支大幅收縮，亞洲出口經濟體將首當其衝。
小摩更提出反直覺判斷，AI投資退潮未必是經濟災難，資本開支回落反給Fed降息空間，對於被壓制的非科技族群是利多。
小摩對科技基本面維持建設性判斷，但提示半導體定價可持續性不足與新興雲融資壓力。該行認為11月初可望出現潛在買入機會，但需同時滿足倉位充分出清、雲廠商確認資本開支方向、半導體盈利經受考驗、信用利差恢復收窄等四大條件。若四者缺一，反彈可持續性便存疑。
對市場而言，目前既非清倉信號，也非無條件抄底時機，答案就藏在本週幾家科技巨頭的業績裡。
paras_en: Global tech stocks are undergoing a rare, concentrated sell‑off. Goldman Sachs data show that over the past two weeks the TMT group logged a net sell‑off of about $20 billion, with selling intensity reaching an extreme -3.3 standard deviations, close to the July‑year‑to‑date $23 billion sell‑off. The Nasdaq‑100 remains trapped in the range it has been oscillating in since May, with the 29,000‑point futures level and the 200‑day moving average around 28,500 points forming the most critical technical support zone today.

Market panic is not spread evenly across the broad market but is highly concentrated in tech stocks. Goldman’s risk‑on/off indicator posted one of the largest single‑day drops on record, falling to its lowest level since April 2025. The volatility spread between the NDX and SPX surged to the 98th percentile of the past five‑year range, and last Thursday (the 22nd) saw the second‑largest one‑day expansion in five years. Tech‑specific volatility pricing is unusually expensive relative to the broader market, TMT net fundamental positions have slipped to their lowest point this year, yet overall leverage remains a potential pain point.

JPMorgan analyst Rich Privorotsky notes that while AI demand stays strong, financing conditions are tightening rapidly. So far this year AI‑related infrastructure debt financing has exceeded $500 billion, and financing costs for ultra‑large cloud service providers have risen roughly 120 basis points compared with earlier levels.

Recently AI‑related CDS spreads have widened noticeably. JPMorgan believes this reflects banks actively buying protection to hedge data‑center exposures rather than a deterioration in fundamentals, but the risk‑transmission pathway is now clearly visible.

The market’s biggest worry is the financing chain of “Nvidia‑GPU operators.” New‑type cloud factories such as CoreWeave rely on customer financing and credit support to expand; if the funding chain tightens, pressure will feed back up the supply chain to upstream chip makers. At present the US semiconductor index is testing its 200‑day moving average, providing technical confirmation of this risk pathway.

Google, Microsoft and Amazon are disclosing earnings intensively on Wednesday and Thursday. Market focus has moved beyond capital‑expenditure guidance to questions about whether backlog orders can be turned into revenue and how the next wave of expansion will be financed. TS Lombard data show South Korean tech exports account for nearly 20% of GDP; a sharp cut in AI cap‑ex would hit Asian export‑driven economies first.

JPMorgan offers a counter‑intuitive view: an AI investment pull‑back may not be an economic disaster. A decline in cap‑ex could give the Fed room to cut rates, which would be a tailwind for the suppressed non‑tech sectors.

JPMorgan remains constructive on tech fundamentals but flags insufficient pricing sustainability in semiconductors and rising financing pressure on emerging cloud players. The bank sees a potential buying opportunity in early November, provided four conditions are met: substantial position unwinding, confirmation of cloud providers’ cap‑ex direction, semiconductor earnings under stress, and a narrowing of credit spreads. Missing any of these would cast doubt on the durability of a rebound.
For the market, this is neither a clear sell‑off signal nor an unconditional bottom‑buying moment; the answer lies in the earnings reports of several tech giants due this week.

items.title: 輝達本益比降至18倍、較標普500折價11%！華爾街喊上看515美元
paras: 人工智慧（AI）浪潮推升輝達(NVDA-US) 市值突破5兆美元，但股價估值卻意外降溫。隨著獲利增長速度超越股價漲幅，輝達目前預估本益比降至18倍，不僅不到2022年底水準的一半，更較標普500指數成分股平均折價11%，創下2015年4月以來最大折價幅度。
根據《Benzinga》報導，市場對輝達的疑慮，主要集中在兩大風險：大型科技企業的AI資本支出能否持續擴張，以及仰賴舉債採購輝達晶片的新興雲端業者，是否面臨融資壓力。
不過，華爾街分析師仍普遍看好輝達後市，認為當前估值可能提供布局機會。
回顧2015年4月，輝達市值僅約120億美元，主要業務是向電玩玩家銷售繪圖晶片。如今，輝達市值已突破5兆美元，成為AI產業發展的核心供應商，但股票相對整體市場的估值，卻再次回到當年以來最便宜的水準。
根據華爾街分析師預估，輝達未來12個月每股盈餘（EPS）將達12.03美元，相較2022年底約0.4美元大幅成長。
然而，以股價約215美元計算，輝達預估本益比約18倍，低於追蹤標普500指數的SPDR標準普爾500指數ETF(SPY-US) 約19倍的本益比。
2022年11月，OpenAI推出ChatGPT時，輝達預估本益比一度超過40倍。此後，公司獲利成長速度遠快於股價漲幅，推動本益比降至不到當時的一半，並接近8年來低點。
截至上週五（23日）收盤，輝達相較標普500指數成分股平均估值折價11%，為2015年4月以來最大差距。當時，輝達的主要客戶仍是電玩玩家，而非如今大舉投入AI基礎設施的超大規模雲端服務業者。

兩大風險壓抑股價：資本支出與融資壓力

第一項疑慮是大型科技企業的AI投資能否持續成長。
微軟(MSFT-US) 、亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 、Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、甲骨文(ORCL-US) 及SpaceX(SPCX-US) 今年資本支出合計預計達9,300億美元，明年更上看1.35兆美元。
然而，後續成長幅度可能放緩。市場預估，相關企業資本支出將於再下一年升至1.45兆美元，之後一年則降至1.415兆美元。
若大型客戶的支出停止成長，輝達的營收成長也可能受到限制。
第二項風險來自新興雲端業者（neocloud）。CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Nebius(YNDX-US) 等公司透過舉債購買輝達晶片，再將運算能力出租給AI開發商。這種商業模式仰賴強勁需求與低廉融資成本，一旦兩項條件出現變化，業者的財務壓力便可能升高。
近期，投資人要求借款給CoreWeave的報酬率已超過16%，該公司股價過去一個月下跌42%；Nebius同期也下跌38%。週一收盤，CoreWeave小幅上升1.76%，Nebius則下跌3.45%。
輝達執行長黃仁勳10月22日也坦言，運算需求遠超過可用於融資的資金規模。當天輝達股價下跌4.4%。
融資問題週一再度浮上檯面。Meta計劃為AI發展籌措950億美元資金，並表示輝達、超微半導體(AMD-US) ）及博通(AVGO-US) 均已表達興趣，願在其股票發行中各自認購最多50億美元。
換言之，晶片供應商如今也可能出資支持自己的大型客戶。

華爾街仍看好輝達 分析師最高喊至515美元

儘管市場疑慮升高，分析師並未因此全面轉趨保守。
根據《Benzinga》追蹤的29名分析師評級，輝達目前獲得一致買進評等，平均目標價為343美元，較約215美元的股價隱含約59%的上漲空間。
過去3個月，分析師目標價介於300至515美元，其中最高價由Raymond James提出。
Needham分析師N. Quinn Bolton於10月22日重申買進評等，目標價維持300美元。
Cantor Fitzgerald 分析師 C.J. Muse 出席黃仁勳在柏林舉行的 GTC 主題演講後，也重申對輝達的「加碼」評等，並維持 350 美元的目標價。
Muse認為，輝達對2027曆年營收成長超過70%的預期，可能相當保守。他指出，市場需求仍足以支撐遠高於100%的成長率，且相關供應協議預計將在3年內使輝達的基板產能擴大至原來的2.5倍。
此外，若以Cantor對輝達2028曆年的獲利預估計算，目前股價對應的本益比不到10倍。Muse認為，這樣的估值讓輝達股票「實在很難忽視」。

市場再次低估輝達？關鍵在客戶是否付得起

2015年，市場將輝達視為成長前景有限的電玩晶片公司，當時的低估後來成為股市歷史上最顯著的定價失誤之一。
如今，投資人再次以近似的懷疑態度看待這家全球主要的 AI 供應商，彷彿其成長即將停滯。
但這次市場的疑慮是否也會被證明是錯誤的，關鍵已不再只是市場對輝達晶片的需求有多強，而在於輝達的客戶是否有能力持續支付相關費用。

items.title: 〈焦點股〉玉晶光攜美商3M推進擴束光學 攻上1245元新天價
items.title_en: Focus Stock: Yujing Optical Teams Up with US 3M to Advance Expanded Beam Optics, Rises to a New High of NT$1,245
paras: 光學精密元件廠玉晶光(3406-TW)確定將攜手美商3M推進擴束光學技術（Expanded Beam Optical, EBO）解決方案的研發、製造與產能擴充，3M對玉晶光以私募增資股款48.13億元已匯入，取得玉晶光約 4.68%股權，玉晶光股價(27)逆勢上漲，盤中最高價達1245元創新天價。
玉晶光2026年9月營收26.72億元，月減1.75%，年增0.54%，2026年1-9月玉晶光營收196.31億元，年增10.21%。玉晶光第三季為客戶傳統鋪貨旺季，單季營收表現也佳，達 78.16 億元，進入歷史高檔區，季增37.55%，年增1%。
玉晶光自結2026年第三季稅後純益10.92億元，每股9.69元，加計上半年財報後稅後純益26.69億元，每股純益達23.68元。
玉晶光與3M的大舉合作，雙方合作結合了 3M 在 EBO 技術的領導地位、材料科學、光學設計及全球客戶網絡，與玉晶光以精密光學鏡頭製造能力、量產規模及高精度組裝技術。玉晶光的生產團隊將全力支援 3M EBO 套管（ferrules）、共封裝光學（CPO）解決方案及相關光互連模組的量產做準備。
paras_en: Optical precision component maker Yujing Optical (3406‑TW) confirmed it will partner with US‑based 3M to develop, manufacture, and expand capacity for Expanded Beam Optical (EBO) solutions. 3M has transferred a private‑placement capital injection of NT$4.813 billion to Yujing Optical, acquiring roughly 4.68% of the company’s shares. The stock (27) rose against the market trend, reaching a session high of NT$1,245, a record peak.

Yujing Optical reported September 2026 revenue of NT$2.672 billion, down 1.75% month‑over‑month but up 0.54% year‑over‑year. For the January‑September 2026 period, revenue totaled NT$19.631 billion, a 10.21% year‑over‑year increase. The third quarter, traditionally a strong distribution season for customers, delivered robust single‑quarter revenue of NT$7.816 billion, entering a historic high range, up 37.55% quarter‑over‑quarter and 1% year‑over‑year.

Yujing Optical posted third‑quarter 2026 after‑tax net profit of NT$1.092 billion, or NT$9.69 per share. Including the first half of the year’s results, the cumulative after‑tax net profit reached NT$2.669 billion, or NT$23.68 earnings per share.

The large‑scale collaboration between Yujing Optical and 3M combines 3M’s leadership in EBO technology, material science, optical design, and its global customer network with Yujing Optical’s precision optical lens manufacturing capability, mass‑production scale, and high‑accuracy assembly expertise. Yujing Optical’s production team will fully support the mass production of 3M’s EBO ferrules, co‑packaged optics (CPO) solutions, and related optical interconnect modules.

items.title: AirTrunk獲42.5億澳幣綠色貸款，推進西雪梨AI資料中心擴建
items.title_en: AirTrunk Secures A$4.25 Billion Green Loan to Advance West Sydney AI Data Centre Expansion
paras: 2026年10月27日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 澳洲超大規模資料中心業者AirTrunk 10月27日宣布，取得42.5億澳幣（約新台幣971億元）綠色貸款，支應西雪梨SYD3園區持續開發。由A W Edwards承建的擴建工程已在施工，預計2028年中完工，將增加雲端運算、AI與企業數位服務所需的資料中心容量。
這筆融資由32家本地及國際金融機構參與，14家銀行負責承銷。SYD3在2021年公布時規劃容量逾320MW，目前官網列示整座園區規模逾400MW；本次公告未揭露此次擴建的新增容量。
AirTrunk主要為大型雲端服務業者提供資料中心基礎設施。SYD3鄰近既有SYD1園區，原先即以承接客戶擴充需求為開發方向。為配合工程設備進場，公司在西雪梨設置2.5萬平方公尺的倉儲與整備區，提供關鍵設備暫存、整備與進場前測試，再依施工需求運抵園區，並以期租船強化設備運輸。
這筆綠色貸款設有利差調整機制。SYD3工程將採用低碳鋼材與混凝土，並以至少90%的非有害營建廢棄物免於送進掩埋場為目標。

paras_en: On October 27, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Australian hyperscale data centre operator AirTrunk announced on October 27 that it has secured a green loan of A$4.25 billion (approximately NT$97.1 billion) to fund the continued development of its West Sydney SYD3 campus. The expansion, built by A W Edwards, is already under construction and is slated for completion in mid‑2028, adding capacity for cloud computing, AI and enterprise digital services.

The financing involves 32 local and international financial institutions, with 14 banks acting as underwriters. When SYD3 was announced in 2021, it was planned to have a capacity of over 320 MW; the company’s website now lists the entire campus at more than 400 MW. The announcement did not disclose the additional capacity that the current expansion will provide.

AirTrunk primarily supplies data‑centre infrastructure to large cloud service providers. SYD3 is adjacent to the existing SYD1 campus and was originally developed to meet customers’ expansion needs. To accommodate equipment delivery, the company has set up a 25,000‑square‑metre warehouse and staging area in West Sydney, where critical equipment can be stored, prepared and tested before being moved onto the site as construction demands, with plans to charter vessels to enhance equipment transport.

The green loan includes a margin‑adjustment mechanism. The SYD3 project will use low‑carbon steel and concrete, and aims for at least 90 % of non‑hazardous construction waste to be diverted from landfills.

items.title: 光通訊股強勢反彈！Lumentum大漲8.19%　AI需求、中國供應限制成利多
items.title_en: Optical Communications Stocks Rally Strongly! Lumentum Jumps 8.19% – AI Demand and China Supply Restrictions Are Catalysts
paras: 人工智慧（AI）基礎建設需求持續支撐光通訊產業，美國光學元件廠商股價週一（26日）強勢反彈。Lumentum(LITE-US) 收漲8.19%，領漲標普500指數成分股；同業 Coherent(COHR-US) 上漲5.83%，Ciena(CIEN-US) 也上漲4.89%。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，Evercore ISI 分析師 Amit Daryanani 指出，上週光通訊類股遭遇賣壓後，市場對該產業重新燃起興趣。
他表示，許多投資人可能也一直在等待人工智慧（AI）新創公司 Anthropic 公布首次公開募股（IPO）的 S-1 註冊文件，之後才重新大舉投入相關交易。
Anthropic 週一已提交 IPO 申請文件，財務資料整體上也為晶片類股帶來提振。
Daryanani 表示，目前 AI 產業公布的財報，從基本面來看仍「相對健康」。此外，Meta(META-US) 宣布發行股票籌資，SpaceX(SPCX-US) 則承諾投入400億美元融資，用於採購晶片及其他 AI 硬體。
這些消息讓投資人在週一看到了 AI 投資交易「持續具備韌性」的跡象。
除了 AI 投資動能，潛在的美國進口限制措施，也成為光通訊產業的另一項利多因素。Daryanani 也提到，市場預期美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）將於明年初限制從海外供應商進口光收發器。
他表示，這項決策「將實質上把中國供應商排除在美國新一代3.2T光收發器市場之外」。
Daryanani 引述一名專家指出，考慮到中國生產的這類元件約占全球總產量的三分之二，相關限制將產生重大影響。
Daryanani 表示，這將為 AI 基礎建設的部署帶來挑戰，但另一方面，任何針對中國的限制措施，都將使美國製造商及其盟友供應商受益。
他指出，亞洲市場週末傳出的另一項關鍵消息，是半導體材料磷化銦（Indium phosphide，InP）的供應增長可能放緩。
Daryanani 認為，這顯示中國供應商在擴大磷化銦產能方面可能面臨挑戰，難以提供足夠符合目前傳輸速度要求的產品。
Daryanani 指出，傳統光通訊產業的景氣循環通常約為5年，但 AI 發展改變了產業節奏，資料傳輸通道的速度幾乎每年都在提升。
Daryanani 指出，傳輸通道速度加快，加上 AI 資料中心所需的互連數量持續增加，應會繼續推動光通訊元件需求。他也表示，資料中心對連接能力的需求增加，將帶動雷射元件需求成長，包括採用磷化銦製造的雷射。
然而，擴充製造產能及完成產品認證均需要時間，短期內供應仍可能受限。Daryanani 認為，在需求持續成長、供應擴張速度有限的情況下，具備擴產能力、且能交付符合高速傳輸規格產品的供應商，將持續受惠。
paras_en: AI infrastructure demand continues to support the optical communications industry, and U.S. optical component makers saw a strong rebound on Monday (the 26th). Lumentum (LITE-US) rose 8.19%, leading the S&P 500 constituents; peer Coherent (COHR-US) gained 5.83% and Ciena (CIEN-US) climbed 4.89%.
According to Barron's, Evercore ISI analyst Amit Daryanani said that after last week’s sell‑off in optical‑communications stocks, the market has rekindled interest in the sector.
He noted that many investors may have been waiting for the AI startup Anthropic to file its S‑1 registration statement for an IPO before re‑entering the space in force.
Anthropic submitted its IPO application on Monday, and its financial disclosures overall gave a boost to chip stocks.

Daryanani said that the AI industry’s recent earnings reports still look "relatively healthy" on a fundamentals basis. In addition, Meta (META-US) announced a stock offering, and SpaceX (SPCX-US) pledged $40 billion in financing for chip and other AI‑hardware purchases.
These developments gave investors on Monday a sign that AI‑related trading remains resilient.

Beyond AI momentum, a potential U.S. import‑restriction measure is another tailwind for the optical‑communications sector. Daryanani added that the market expects the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) to restrict imports of optical transceivers from overseas suppliers early next year.
He said that the decision would "effectively exclude Chinese suppliers from the U.S. next‑generation 3.2‑Tbps optical transceiver market."
Citing an expert, Daryanani noted that Chinese manufacturers account for roughly two‑thirds of global production of these components, so the restriction would have a major impact.
He said this will pose challenges for AI‑infrastructure deployment, but any restrictions on China will benefit U.S. manufacturers and their allied suppliers.
He pointed out another key weekend development in Asia: the supply growth of the semiconductor material indium phosphide (InP) may be slowing.
Daryanani believes this indicates Chinese suppliers could struggle to expand InP capacity and may be unable to meet the product specifications required for current transmission speeds.

He explained that the traditional optical‑communications industry follows a roughly five‑year cyclical pattern, but AI development is reshaping the rhythm, with data‑channel speeds improving almost every year.

He added that faster transmission channels and the growing number of interconnects needed by AI data centers will continue to drive demand for optical‑communication components, including lasers made from indium phosphide.

However, expanding manufacturing capacity and completing product certifications take time, so short‑term supply may remain constrained. Daryanani believes that, with demand rising and supply expansion limited, suppliers capable of scaling production and delivering high‑speed‑spec products will continue to benefit.

items.title: 警示「人類毀滅風險」卻吸金千億美元 解析AI獨角獸Anthropic招股書
paras: 美國人工智慧(AI)獨角獸企業 Anthropic 正式向美國證券交易委員會(SEC)遞交 S-1 註冊文件，啟動首次公開募股(IPO)流程。公司申請在納斯達克全球精選市場掛牌，股票代碼定為「ANT」。
據知情人士透露，Anthropic 預計最快於 2026 年 11 月 16 日當周上市。本次 IPO 預計籌集資金高達 1,000 億美元甚至更多，上市估值上看 1.5 兆至 2 兆美元。若以 2 兆美元上限計算，Anthropic 將一舉超越 SpaceX，刷新全球歷史上規模最大的 IPO 紀錄。

半年營收狂飆162億美元與巨額帳面虧損

招股書揭露了 Anthropic 成立以來極為罕見的財務擴張速度。公司營收從 2023 年的 4,100 萬美元跳升至 2024 年的 3.86 億美元，並於 2025 年達到 45.85 億美元。到了 2026 年上半年，Anthropic 營收已爆發性成長至 162.86 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 11.63 億美元大增約 1,300%(約 14 倍)。
按最新營收推算，其年化收入運行率已達 650 億美元規模。其中，基於用量計費(pay-for-intelligence)的消費型收入占總營收約 80%(131 億美元)，訂閱收入占 20%(32 億美元)。
然而，伴隨驚人營收成長的是龐大的 GAAP 淨虧損。2025 年全年淨虧損為 419.65 億美元，而 2026 年上半年淨虧損更擴大至 807.48 億美元。
招股書特別說明，2026 年上半年的淨虧損中，有高達 723.88 億美元(近 90%)源自可轉換公司債、衍生負債及未來股權簡單協議(SAFE)公允價值變動所產生的非現金損失。主因是公司私人市場估值暴漲，導致未償還可轉換公司債的帳面估值大幅推高，並非經營層面的實質現金失血。
若回歸實際本業經營，Anthropic 的營業虧損已明顯收窄：2026 年上半年營業虧損降至 6.93 億美元(2025 年同期為 21.35 億美元)；剔除股票薪酬等項目後，2026 年上半年調整後營業利潤轉正達到 16.18 億美元，營業利潤率達 10%。
截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日，Anthropic 帳上持有高達 1,316.51 億美元的現金、現金等價物及短期投資，資金儲備充裕。

淨收入留存率高達 900%

在商業化拓展上，Anthropic 展現出對企業客戶的強大吸引力。截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日，其合格企業客戶的淨收入留存率(NRR)約為 900%，意味著既有客戶在嵌入關鍵業務工作流後，消費金額呈現指數級放大。
招股書揭露了 Anthropic 企業客戶的三層台階：

年貢獻收入 ≥ 10 萬美元的客戶超過 11,900 家(一年前僅約 950 家)。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 100 萬美元的客戶超過 1,900 家。
年貢獻收入 ≥ 1,000 萬美元的巨型客戶約 250 家。


在大型企業覆蓋率方面，《財富》500 強(Fortune 500)已有超過 50% 的企業成為 Anthropic 的付費客戶，全球 2000 強(Global 2000)覆蓋率超過 30%，《財富》前 10 強企業更是 100% 採用。產品陣容除了 Claude 基礎模型平台外，亦包含專為軟體開發設計的 AI 智慧體(AI Agent)Claude Code，以及面向知識工作者的 Claude Cowork。
隨著企業大規模調用，Anthropic 過去 12 個月的人均營收從 140 萬美元躍升至 660 萬美元以上，全公司員工數約 5,300 人。

招股書警示「人類毀滅風險」

令人關注的是，Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中列出了長達 93 頁的風險因素(從第 26 頁至第 119 頁)。相較之下，SpaceX 的風險因素僅 37 頁，微軟為 40 頁，Coinbase 為 60 頁。
1. 官方警告與「模型失齊」事件
Anthropic 在招股書第 46 頁明確寫道：
「若缺乏適當的安全防護、監督與安全措施，充分先進的人工智慧系統在開發、部署及運作過程中，可能會對人類造成毀滅性或存在性風險(catastrophic or existential risks to humanity)。」
公司同時承認已觀察到模型出現「未對齊(misaligned)」的異常行為。招股書透露，在一項內部測試中，早期版本模型在無法終止一項不可能完成的任务後，竟自行利用搜尋到的密碼，未經授權取得第三方系統的管理員權限、蒐集憑證、變更系統設定並讀取個人隱私資料。
Anthropic 坦言，實施預防性安全措施或延後模型發布，可能會削弱其相較於未受限競爭對手的優勢，並對營收成長造成不利影響。
2. 外部評論
對此，知名 AI 評論家、紐約大學(NYU)名譽教授馬庫斯(Gary Marcus)在社群平台 X 上發表強烈批評，指責 Anthropic 在招股書中故意刻意隱瞞數據、企圖「規避真相」：
馬庫斯指出：「Anthropic 在 S-1 招股書中迴避了第三季度的財務數據。這種省略說明了一切——需求正在下降，經濟效益並未改善。一家標榜以信任為核心建構的公司，現在卻試圖規避真相(skirt the truth)。」
另一方面，佛羅里達大學 IPO 計畫主任、被譽為「IPO 先生」的Jay Ritter在接受《USA TODAY》採訪時分析，一般公司在招股書中警告的通常是利率或油價上漲，Anthropic 的做法極為罕見。
Ritter表示：「任何公司都不常見在風險章節中表達對產品可能導致『大規模滅絕事件』的擔憂……在公開說明書中將其列為風險因素是非常罕見的。」
Ritter進一步指出：「如果這是一個眼前真正的威脅，我們應該會看到全球金融資產價格暴跌，人們會想：『如果我明年就要死了，為什麼還要存錢？』但全球並未出現金融資產的大規模拋售，這表明雖然風險存在，但只要公司保持警惕並採取預防措施，投資人傾向認為事情不會發生。大家不必過度恐慌，因為公司已經在為此擔憂了。」

算力基礎設施與全球 AI 資本競賽

算力仍是 Anthropic 最沉重的剛性支出。2026 年上半年，其算力與基礎設施費用高達 89.45 億美元。不過效率指標顯示，2026 年第二季度營收同比成長 1,368% 的同時，算力費用僅成長 300%，顯示營收成長速度已超過算力成本的攀升幅度。新一代模型 Claude Opus 5.5 相較 Opus 5 也成功將客戶單次任務成本降低了約 40%。
在算力供應上，Anthropic 採用多晶片架構，同時調度 AWS Trainium、Google TPU、輝達 GPU 與 AMD GPU。同時，公司最大的戰略投資者與雲端夥伴亞馬遜與Google，均在 2026 年 5 月的 H 輪融資中分別追加了 50 億美元與 100 億美元的股權投資，並保留了數百億美元規模的可轉換公司債額度。

items.title: 暫停升息不代表緊縮循環結束 本週Fed會議有哪些重點？
items.title_en: A Pause in Rate Hikes Does Not Signal the End of Tightening Cycle: Key Points of This Week's Fed Meeting
paras: 《Investopedia》報導，市場普遍預期，美國聯準會(Fed)官員將在週三的會議上維持基準利率不變，釋出在對抗通膨方面採取耐心態度的訊號。
根據 CME Group 的 FedWatch 工具，金融市場目前認為，聯邦公開市場委員會 (FOMC) 在這週的會議上投票決定升息 0.25 個百分點的機率約為 10%。
近幾週，聯準會官員公開討論是否應在 9 月升息 0.25 個百分點後，再次升息，以因應高於預期的通膨。儘管部分官員表達了擔憂，但也有其他官員主張採取觀望態度。
聯邦資金利率上升，意味著各類貸款的借貸成本都會提高，這可能抑制消費支出，進而壓低通膨。不過，升息也可能對就業市場及整體經濟造成拖累。
聯準會必須在國會賦予的雙重使命之間取得平衡，也就是維持低通膨與高就業率。通膨目前已連續第五年高於聯準會的目標，而失業率則徘徊在歷史低點附近。多數專家預期，即使聯準會放棄在 10 月升息，仍可能在 12 月再次升息。
牛津經濟研究院 (Oxford Economics) 首席美國經濟學家Michael Pearce在一篇評論中寫道，「所有跡象都顯示，聯準會短期內可能仍需要持續升息。然而，幾位關鍵官員近期的發言暗示，聯準會不太可能在 10 月的政策會議上採取升息行動。」
聯邦公開市場委員會的兩位重要成員——聯準會理事鮑曼 (Michelle Bowman)及紐約聯準銀行總裁威廉斯 (John C. Williams)——近期的談話都暗示，他們並不傾向在連續兩次會議上都升息。
高盛首席美國經濟學家 David Mericle 在評論中指出，近期聯準會官員的發言顯示，多數官員可能支持每隔一次會議升息 0.25 個百分點。若採取這種節奏，接下來兩次升息將分別落在 12 月與明年 3 月。
除了利率決策之外，週三會議最受關注的環節，將是聯準會主席華許 (Kevin Warsh) 舉行的記者會。不過，如果華許維持一貫作風，他將避免透露未來貨幣政策決策的線索。與過去的聯準會主席不同，華許一直採取不向金融市場提供「前瞻指引」的政策。
即便如此，他的談話即使有所保留，仍可能透露一些重要訊息。
野村證券經濟學家Ruchir Sharma在評論中寫道，「華許主席不太可能在記者會上直接提供任何前瞻指引，但我們預期，他將以間接方式支持 12 月升息。」
他進一步指出，「華許如何描述近期的通膨數據與金融市場狀況，可能提供一些線索，讓我們了解聯準會在 2027 年進一步緊縮貨幣政策的門檻。」
paras_en: Investopedia reports that the market broadly expects Federal Reserve officials to keep the benchmark interest rate unchanged at Wednesday’s meeting, signaling a patient stance in the fight against inflation.

According to CME Group’s FedWatch tool, financial markets currently assign roughly a 10% probability that the Federal Open Market Committee will vote to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point at this week’s meeting.

In recent weeks, Fed officials have publicly debated whether to raise rates by 0.25 percentage point in September and then again to address inflation that is running hotter than expected. While some officials voiced concerns, others advocated a wait‑and‑see approach.

Higher federal funds rates mean higher borrowing costs across all types of loans, which could dampen consumer spending and thus ease inflation. However, rate hikes could also weigh on the labor market and the broader economy.

The Fed must balance its dual mandate from Congress—maintaining low inflation and high employment. Inflation has now been above the Fed’s target for a fifth consecutive year, while unemployment hovers near historic lows. Most experts expect that even if the Fed skips a hike in October, it may raise rates again in December.

Oxford Economics chief U.S. economist Michael Pearce wrote in a commentary that “all signs point to the Fed likely needing to keep raising rates in the short term. Yet, recent remarks by several key officials suggest the Fed is unlikely to hike at the October policy meeting.”

Two prominent members of the Federal Open Market Committee—Fed Governor Michelle Bowman and New York Fed President John C. Williams—have recently hinted that they are not inclined to raise rates at two consecutive meetings.

Goldman Sachs chief U.S. economist David Mericle noted that recent comments from Fed officials indicate most may favor a 0.25‑percentage‑point hike every other meeting. At that pace, the next two hikes would fall in December and March of next year.

Beyond the rate decision, the most closely watched part of Wednesday’s meeting will be the press conference held by Fed Chair Kevin Warsh. However, if Warsh sticks to his usual style, he will avoid giving clues about future monetary‑policy decisions. Unlike past Fed chairs, Warsh has consistently refrained from providing “forward guidance” to financial markets.
Even so, his remarks—though guarded—could still reveal some important information.

Nomura Securities economist Ruchir Sharma wrote that “Chair Warsh is unlikely to give any direct forward guidance at the press conference, but we expect he will indirectly support a December rate hike.”
He added that “how Warsh describes recent inflation data and financial‑market conditions may provide clues about the thresholds for further tightening by the Fed in 2027.”

items.title: 與SpaceX合併有戲 特斯拉賣出評等占比創11年新低
items.title_en: Merger Talk with SpaceX Sparks Hope; Tesla's Sell Rating Share Hits 11-Year Low
paras: 隨著特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 備受期待的合併案逐漸接近成真，分析師對這家電動車廠的股價展望迅速轉趨樂觀，給予特斯拉股票悲觀評等的分析師占比，已降至逾 11 年來最低。
法國巴黎銀行與里昂證券分析師上周分別將評等從相當於「賣出」調升至「中立」與「持有」。巴克萊周一(26日)跟進，將評等從相當於「持有」調升至「買進」。特斯拉股價周一上漲 5.2%。
巴克萊分析師 Dan Levy 在報告中寫道：「市場預期的合併案如今已成為看好特斯拉的重要理由，因為這為股價帶來上漲空間。」
馬斯克表示，特斯拉與 SpaceX 董事會已成立特別委員會，評估交易效益，讓合併熱潮升至高點。早在 SpaceX 今年 6 月上市前，華爾街就已關注馬斯克旗下這兩家最大企業合併的可能性。
法國巴黎銀行分析師 James Picariello 在報告中表示，潛在合併案如今已成為「主導估值的考量因素」，儘管他對特斯拉的現金消耗與 AI 發展速度仍抱持審慎態度。
他將目標價從 266 美元調高至 420 美元，「完全」反映 SpaceX 收購特斯拉的可能性升高。
Zacks Investment Research 策略師 Andrew Rocco 在報告中寫道：「若要讓合併案獲准，兩家公司的獨立特別委員會必須協商出合理的交易條件。假設收購溢價為 25%，特斯拉每股價值將約為 500 美元。」
彭博追蹤的 60 名分析師中，僅 5 人建議賣出特斯拉股票，悲觀評等占比創 2015 年初以來最低。相較之下，今年 1 月 1 日的 71 名分析師中，有 15 人給予賣出評等。
儘管今年賣出評等占比下降，買進評等占比仍相對穩定。特斯拉股價今年以來下跌 13%，同期標普 500 指數則上漲 12%。
特斯拉目標遠大，但過去屢次延後實現承諾，讓投資人與分析師難以確定，其 AI 計畫何時能帶來回報，甚至能否實現。
即使沒有合併案，特斯拉業務也已處於轉折點，馬斯克正試圖透過自駕計程車與機器人助理，將公司從電動車製造商轉型為實體 AI 的先驅。
同樣積極進軍 AI 的 SpaceX，今年稍早已將馬斯克旗下 xAI 納入旗下，並已與特斯拉合作推動 Terafab 晶片製造計畫，以及號稱能對抗地心引力的 Roadster 等特殊工程產品。兩家公司若合併，可能催生一家由馬斯克掌舵、價值 3.6 兆美元的 AI 集團。
特斯拉上周公布的第三季獲利優於預期，但因下修 2026 年全年支出預估，股價出現震盪，投資人質疑公司投入的資金是否足以達成目標。
不過，巴克萊分析師 Levy 表示，這份財報在核心汽車業務與自駕計程車領域，釋出「多項足以支撐股價走強的重要利多」。
paras_en: As the much‑anticipated merger between Tesla (TSLA-US) and SpaceX (SPCX-US) draws nearer to reality, analysts have become quickly more optimistic about the EV maker’s stock outlook, driving the share of analysts assigning a sell rating to a low not seen in over 11 years.

BNP Paribas and Lyon Securities analysts each upgraded their ratings last week from a sell‑equivalent to neutral and hold, respectively. Barclays followed on Monday the 26th, raising its rating from a hold‑equivalent to buy. Tesla’s share price rose 5.2% on Monday.
Barclays analyst Dan Levy wrote in his report: “The market‑expected merger has now become a key bullish catalyst for Tesla, as it adds upside potential to the stock.”

Elon Musk said that a special committee has been formed by the Tesla and SpaceX boards to evaluate the deal’s merits, pushing merger enthusiasm to a peak. Wall Street had been eyeing the possibility of combining Musk’s two biggest companies even before SpaceX’s June IPO this year.

BNP Paribas analyst James Picariello noted in his note that the potential merger has become the “dominant valuation factor,” though he remains cautious about Tesla’s cash burn and the pace of its AI development.
He raised the target price from $266 to $420, fully reflecting the heightened probability of a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla.

Zacks Investment Research strategist Andrew Rocco wrote: “For the merger to be approved, the independent special committees of both companies must negotiate reasonable deal terms. Assuming a 25% acquisition premium, Tesla’s per‑share value would be roughly $500.”

Among the 60 analysts tracked by Bloomberg, only five recommend selling Tesla shares, marking the lowest sell‑rating proportion since early 2015. By contrast, of the 71 analysts on Jan. 1, 15 had issued sell ratings.
Even though the sell‑rating share has fallen this year, the buy‑rating share remains relatively stable. Tesla’s stock is down 13% year‑to‑date, while the S&P 500 has risen 12% over the same period.
Tesla’s ambitions are lofty, but repeated delays in delivering on promises have left investors and analysts uncertain about when its AI initiatives will pay off, or even if they will materialize.

Even without a merger, Tesla’s business is at a turning point, with Musk trying to pivot the company from an electric‑vehicle maker to a pioneer of embodied AI through autonomous taxis and robot assistants.

SpaceX, also aggressively pursuing AI, recently folded Musk’s xAI under its umbrella and has partnered with Tesla on the Terafab chip‑manufacturing project and on special‑engineered products such as the purported gravity‑defying Roadster. A merger could spawn a Musk‑run AI conglomerate valued at $3.6 trillion.

Tesla reported third‑quarter earnings last week that beat expectations, but the stock wavered after the company cut its full‑year 2026 spending outlook, prompting investors to question whether its capital allocation is sufficient to meet its goals.

Nevertheless, Barclays analyst Levy said the earnings release delivered “multiple significant positives in the core automotive and autonomous‑taxi segments that are enough to support a stronger stock.”

items.title: Jefferies看半導體設備旺到2028年 AI投資疑慮擋不住需求
items.title_en: Jefferies Sees Semiconductor Equipment Demand Strong Through 2028, AI Investment Concerns Won’t Damp Demand
paras: Jefferies 預期，儘管市場對 AI 投資、資料中心建設及記憶體價格的疑慮為半導體產業帶來壓力，半導體生產設備市場仍將持續擴張至 2028 年。
半導體業者與設備大廠在9月結束的季度財報中，對營運基本面展現出更強的信心；然而，股票市場對未來風險的擔憂，卻拉大了當前營運表現與股價預期之間的落差。
近期市場關注的焦點，包含超大規模雲端業者（Hyperscalers）資本支出的永續性、資料中心面臨的電力限制與施工延宕、主要AI巨頭之間的財務連結，以及居高不下的記憶體價格。
此外，關於生成式AI投資報酬率的質疑，以及日益自主化的AI系統所帶來的風險，也再度浮上檯面。
不過，Jefferies 預期，隨著 AI 應用日益普及，將持續支撐資料中心所需的繪圖處理器（GPU）、客製化晶片、中央處理器（CPU）、功率半導體及其他零組件需求，記憶體需求也可望持續成長。
半導體公司與客戶簽訂的長期供應協議，提高了中期需求能見度，也支持設備製造商對成長延續至 2028 年的預期。
Jefferies 預估，晶圓製造設備市場規模在 2027 年最高可達 2,000 億美元，2028 年約為 2,200 億美元，相較投資人對這兩年的預估分別為 2,000 億美元與 2,500 億美元，可能略顯保守。儘管如此，該市場仍可望維持強勁成長至 2028 年。
個股評等方面，Jefferies 給予應用材料(AMAT-US) 、科林研發(LRCX-US) 、輝達(NVDA-US) 、CoreWeave(CRWV-US) 、Meta(META-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)「買進」評等；對ASML(ASML-US) 與 SCREEN Holdings(DINRF-US)則給予「持有」評等。
paras_en: Jefferies expects that despite market concerns over AI investment, data‑center construction and memory prices putting pressure on the semiconductor industry, the semiconductor manufacturing equipment market will continue to expand through 2028.

Semiconductor companies and major equipment makers showed stronger confidence in their operating fundamentals in the quarterly earnings reports that ended in September, yet the stock market’s worries about future risks have widened the gap between current operating performance and stock‑price expectations.

Recent market focus includes the sustainability of capital spending by hyperscalers, power constraints and construction delays at data centers, financial linkages among leading AI giants, and persistently high memory prices.
In addition, questions about the return on investment for generative‑AI and the risks posed by increasingly autonomous AI systems have resurfaced.

Nevertheless, Jefferies expects that as AI applications become more widespread, they will continue to support demand for GPUs, custom chips, CPUs, power semiconductors and other components needed by data centers, and memory demand is also expected to keep growing.
Long‑term supply agreements signed between semiconductor firms and their customers have improved mid‑term demand visibility and support equipment manufacturers’ outlook for growth through 2028.

Jefferies projects the wafer‑fab equipment market could reach up to $200 billion in 2027 and about $220 billion in 2028, compared with investors’ forecasts of $200 billion and $250 billion for those years, suggesting a slightly more conservative view. Nonetheless, the market is still expected to maintain strong growth through 2028.

For individual stock ratings, Jefferies gives a “Buy” rating to Applied Materials (AMAT‑US), Lam Research (LRCX‑US), NVIDIA (NVDA‑US), CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), Meta (META‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US), and a “Hold” rating to ASML (ASML‑US) and SCREEN Holdings (DINRF‑US).

items.title: 韓媒：三星電子與SK海力士2027年第二季量產8層HBM4供應輝達
items.title_en: Korean Media: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix to Mass‑Produce 8‑Stack HBM4 for Nvidia in Q2 2027
paras: 外媒最新報導指出，三星電子、SK海力打算在2027年第2季實現八層堆疊(8Hi)HBM4記憶體堆疊的全面量產並向輝達出貨。
《ZDNET Korea》 週一(26日)報導指出，南韓兩大DRAM製造商三星電子、SK 海力士目前產出的HBM4記憶體主要為容量更大的 12層堆疊(Hi)版本，但也意味單一堆棧中包含更多DRAM Die，同等頻寬成本更高、堆疊更少，且堆疊更高也意味著良率的下滑。
輝達在今年第3季就8Hi HBM 供應事宜同兩大原廠進行了認真討論，這項計畫變更主要因為輝達考慮在Rubin Ultra和標準Rubin中應用8Hi HBM4(E)，以改善整體供應鏈。
輝達已將HGX Vera Rubin NVL8和HGX Rubin NVL8規格調整為系統合計2TB HBM4，對應著8Hi 32GB的HBM4堆疊。
目前，HBM4供應仍處於爬坡階段，三星、SK海力士的良率與產能直接限制Vera Rubin平台的交付節奏。
paras_en: Foreign media reports that Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix plan to achieve full‑scale mass production of eight‑stack (8Hi) HBM4 memory in the second quarter of 2027 and ship it to Nvidia.

ZDNET Korea reported on Monday (the 26th) that South Korea’s two major DRAM manufacturers, Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, are currently producing HBM4 memory mainly in the larger 12‑stack (Hi) version, which means more DRAM dies per stack, higher bandwidth cost for the same bandwidth, fewer stacks, and higher stack counts also imply lower yields.

Nvidia held serious discussions with the two major suppliers in Q3 of this year regarding 8Hi HBM supply; the plan change is mainly because Nvidia is considering using 8Hi HBM4(E) in both Rubin Ultra and the standard Rubin to improve the overall supply chain.
Nvidia has adjusted the specifications of HGX Vera Rubin NVL8 and HGX Rubin NVL8 to a system‑wide total of 2 TB HBM4, corresponding to an 8Hi 32 GB HBM4 stack.
Currently, HBM4 supply is still in a ramp‑up phase, and the yields and capacity of Samsung and SK Hynix directly limit the delivery pace of the Vera Rubin platform.

昨日路透調查多數經濟學家預測紐西蘭央行(RBNZ)週三將實施今年第三次升息，市場完全消化RBNZ加息25個基點，同時等待澳洲通貨膨脹數據週三出爐，可能決定澳洲央行(RBA)近期是否升息，支撐紐元及澳幣，而且法國社會動盪及財政捉襟見肘，但評級機構穆迪未下調該國信用評級，使法國公債拋售暫歇，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1226高點。

隨後伊福經濟研究所(Ifo)表示，德國10月企業景氣判斷指數升至90.2高於預期，但歐洲央行(ECB)調查顯示，因燃料價格上漲和成本攀升影響財務，歐元區企業從銀行獲得信貸的難度升高，而且法國抗議團體和工會呼籲10月31日舉行進一步示威，並發動11月5日全國大罷工，力圖繼續向政府施壓，社會動盪未息及預算問題惡化的擔憂打擊歐元，而且高油價對依賴能源進口的歐元區經濟構成壓力，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1172低點價位。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1175-95，支撐於1.1090-1.1110。
◆GBP/USD

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 歐元在央行會議前走弱 巴西雷亞爾重挫
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Euro Weakens Ahead of Central Bank Meetings, Brazilian Real Plummets
paras: 美元周一(26日)上漲， 在各國央行即將召開一連串重要會議之際，歐元兌美元匯率下跌，同時原油價格持續處於高檔。另一方面，巴西總統魯拉（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）意外勝選後，巴西雷亞爾大幅貶值。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.31%，報102。
上週由於法國政府公債遭到拋售，法國的債務風險溢酬升至自 2011 年歐洲主權債務危機以來最高，再度引發市場對歐元區可能重陷金融壓力的擔憂，歐元因此承壓。
不過，穆迪（Moody’s）上週並未調降法國的信用評等，緩解了市場部分疑慮。週一，法國政府公債（OAT）價格因此上漲，讓這個正努力改善財政困境的政府稍稍鬆了一口氣。
歐元兌美元下跌 0.21%，至每歐元 1.1179 美元。但歐元兌日元上漲 0.31%，至每歐元 176.04 日元。
法國興業銀行（Société Générale）首席外匯策略師Kit Juckes表示，「歐元面臨的基本問題並沒有改變，而且各國公債利差已經收窄。歐元目前仍容易受到衝擊，因為經濟成長前景不佳，能源價格也依然居高不下。」
布蘭特原油期貨價格雖然小幅回落，但仍維持在近六個月高點附近。油價高漲會對歐元區等仰賴能源進口的經濟體造成壓力。布蘭特原油下跌 0.78%，收於每桶 115.81 美元。
儘管美國面臨通膨上升等不利因素，但穩健的經濟數據仍為美元提供支撐。上週在科技股領跌的市場賣壓中，美元也曾面臨拋售壓力。
本週稍晚，五家主要央行將公布貨幣政策決策。市場預期，美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）都將維持利率不變，儘管通膨壓力依然存在。
紐西蘭與加拿大的央行則預計將在本週升息。

Juckes表示，「美元的表現沒有預期中那麼強勢，也面臨一些不利因素，但美國經濟數據一直相當穩健。」
巴西雷亞爾大幅下挫
巴西總統魯拉於週日勝選，取得歷史性的第四個任期。面對前總統波索納洛（Jair Bolsonaro）長子、參議員Flávio Bolsonaro，魯拉贏得選舉，巴西雷亞爾兌美元匯率隨即大幅下跌。
Bolsonaro在第一輪投票中領先，但在第二輪決選中以超過 400 萬票的差距落敗，震撼了原本押注他會勝選的巴西金融市場。
Bolsonaro拒絕承認敗選，並承諾將要求撤銷選舉結果。
高盛分析師團隊由Teresa Alves領銜，他們在提供投資人的研究報告中表示，「選舉結果若遭到更長時間的爭議，將對市場情緒產生負面影響。更根本的問題是，我們認為巴西雷亞爾及其他當地資產應反映更高的財政風險溢酬，尤其是近幾週政府已大幅放寬財政政策。」
分析師進一步指出，「在先前針對較差財政結果所進行的美元兌雷亞爾匯率評估中，我們認為 5.40 的匯率水準，相當於 2024 年 9 月市場所反映的財政風險溢酬；當時政府尚未在同年 11 月宣布額外的財政措施。至於 5.80 的水準，則代表更高程度的財政風險溢酬，類似於 2024 年 12 月的情況。」

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.31% to 102.

Last week, French sovereign bonds were sold off, pushing France’s debt risk premium to its highest level since the 2011 European sovereign debt crisis, reviving market worries that the euro area could once again face financial pressure, and the euro came under strain.

However, Moody’s did not downgrade France’s credit rating last week, easing some market concerns. On Monday, French OAT prices rose, giving the government, which is working to improve its fiscal situation, a slight sigh of relief.
The euro fell 0.21% to $1.1179, while the euro gained 0.31% against the yen, reaching ¥176.04 per euro.

Société Générale chief FX strategist Kit Juckes said, “The euro’s fundamental problems have not changed, and sovereign‑bond spreads have narrowed. The euro remains vulnerable because growth prospects are weak and energy prices stay high.”
Brent crude futures slipped slightly but stayed near six‑month highs. High oil prices pressure economies that rely on energy imports, such as the euro area. Brent fell 0.78% to $115.81 a barrel.

Despite adverse factors like rising inflation in the United States, solid economic data continue to support the dollar. Last week, amid market selling led by tech stocks, the dollar also faced selling pressure.

Later this week, five major central banks will announce policy decisions. Markets expect the Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan to keep rates unchanged, even though inflation pressures persist.
The Reserve Banks of New Zealand and Canada are expected to raise rates this week.
The yen slipped 0.43% to ¥157.46 per dollar.
Juckes added, “The dollar’s performance is not as strong as expected and faces some headwinds, but U.S. economic data have remained quite robust.”
Brazilian real plunges
President Lula won a historic fourth term on Sunday. After defeating former President Jair Bolsonaro’s son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, the real immediately fell sharply against the dollar.
Bolsonaro led in the first round but lost the runoff by more than four million votes, shocking Brazilian financial markets that had bet on his victory.
Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat and says he will seek to overturn the election results.

Goldman Sachs analysts led by Teresa Alves wrote in a research note that “If the election outcome remains contested for a longer period, market sentiment will suffer. More fundamentally, we believe the real and other local assets should reflect a higher fiscal‑risk premium, especially as the government has recently relaxed fiscal policy dramatically.”

The analysts further noted, “In our earlier USD/BRL valuation based on poorer fiscal outcomes, we considered a rate of 5.40 as reflecting the fiscal‑risk premium priced by the market in September 2024, before the government announced additional fiscal measures in November. A level of 5.80 would imply an even higher fiscal‑risk premium, similar to the situation in December 2024.”
The Brazilian real fell 8.5% against the dollar, reaching 5.4 reais per dollar.

items.title: 十月累漲4.6%！瑞士股市成為市場AI恐慌下的避風港
items.title_en: October Up 4.6%: Swiss Market Becomes a Safe Haven Amid AI Panic
paras: 瑞士股指本月迄今累計上漲4.6%，而歐元區大盤指數歐洲Stoxx 50同期跌幅則達3.2%，兩者近8個百分點的超額收益創2020年3月以來最高。這一反差背後是歐洲投資人在融資成本走高、AI交易遇冷及法西政局動盪之際，主動降低風險敞口，轉向防禦資產。
上漲幾乎全由三大權重股拉動：羅氏漲12%、諾華漲6.7%、雀巢漲10%，這三檔老牌防禦龍頭貢獻指數全部漲幅，合計佔指數近半權重。
EFG資產管理指出，資金正從擁擠的AI交易撤出，回流獲利紮實、對利率敏感度低的醫藥與食品部門。美銀調查也顯示，淨16%的基金經理人最看好瑞士股市。
支撐行情的還有獲利預期改善。根據《彭博資訊》數據顯示，成分企業2027年獲利成長預期上升至10%，幾乎今年兩倍。
瑞士知名私人銀行薩夫拉薩辛銀行策略師Wolf von Rotberg上調評級至「跑贏大盤」，稱利率、美元及宏觀週期見頂三大因素均利好瑞士市場。
但估值隱憂浮現。經過一輪急漲，瑞士股指相對Stoxx 50的比價重回近兩年高位，估值偏貴限制上行空間。
此外，瑞士法郎本月因避險需求反彈，恐擾動出口導向大盤股獲利。市場正權衡防禦屬性與高估值壓力，修復行情能否延續仍待觀察。
paras_en: Swiss equities have risen 4.6% so far this month, while the Euro‑zone’s broad Stoxx 50 index has fallen 3.2% over the same period, delivering an excess return of nearly eight percentage points – the widest gap since March 2020. The divergence reflects European investors trimming risk exposure as financing costs rise, AI‑driven trading cools, and political turmoil spikes, prompting a shift toward defensive assets.

The gains are almost entirely driven by three heavyweight stocks: Roche up 12%, Novartis up 6.7% and Nestlé up 10%. These three long‑standing defensive leaders account for almost half of the index’s weight and contributed the full upside of the index.

EFG Asset Management notes that capital is flowing out of crowded AI trades and back into solid‑earning, low‑rate‑sensitivity sectors such as pharmaceuticals and food. A Bank of America survey also shows that a net 16% of fund managers are most bullish on Swiss equities.

The rally is also supported by improving earnings expectations. Bloomberg data indicate that the component companies’ profit‑growth outlook for 2027 has risen to 10%, roughly double the forecast made earlier this year.

Wolf von Rotberg, a strategist at Swiss private bank Safra Sarasin, upgraded his rating to “outperform,” saying that peaking interest rates, a strong dollar and a top‑of‑the‑cycle macro environment are all favorable for the Swiss market.

However, valuation concerns are emerging. After a sharp rally, the Swiss index’s price‑to‑Stoxx 50 multiple has returned to near‑two‑year highs, making the market look expensive and capping further upside potential.

In addition, the Swiss franc has rebounded this month on safe‑haven demand, which could hurt profit margins of export‑oriented large‑cap stocks. The market is weighing defensive appeal against overvaluation pressure, and it remains to be seen whether the rally can be sustained.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元上漲 日元因AI股重挫轉強 法國債務疑慮拖累歐元
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises, Yen Gains After AI Stock Plunge, French Debt Concerns Drag Euro
paras: 美元周五(23日)小幅上漲，美元指數本週變動不大。歐元則受法國政府公債遭拋售影響走低，法國債務風險溢酬升至2011年歐元區主權債務危機以來最高水準，歐元兌美元與日元均以週線收黑作收。日元受惠於週四AI概念股遭拋售引發的避險資金流入，兌美元本週上漲。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.25%，報101.82，本週上漲約0.03%。
市場對法國國內動盪加劇及預算問題惡化的憂慮，持續打擊歐元。法國內政部長Laurent Nuñez表示，法國將於週六部署7萬名警察，並由特種警力支援，以因應抗議活動。此外，穆迪（Moody’s）也可能於週五調降法國的信用評等。
Bannockburn Global Forex 首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler 表示，「今天歐洲債券市場的壓力已有所緩解，但穆迪稍晚對法國債務評等的檢視仍是一項挑戰。儘管馬克宏政府已威脅動用軍事力量平息社會動盪，但週末可能仍會有更多活動發生。」
歐元兌美元下跌0.21%，至1.1191美元，本週下跌約0.43%。
歐元兌日元跌幅更大，一度觸及175.08日圓，創2025年10月以來最低。歐元兌日元下跌0.11%，本週跌約1.1%。
日元兌美元下跌0.1%，至156.9日元，但本週上漲約0.7%，創下9月中旬以來最佳單週表現。
三菱日聯金融集團（MUFG）資深外匯分析師 Lee Hardman 表示，「隨著本週尾聲的避險交易氣氛升溫，日元持續維持在較強勢水準。」
央行政策會議成市場焦點
交易員正關注下週美國聯準會（Fed）、歐洲央行（ECB）及日本銀行（BoJ）的政策會議。市場預期三家央行都將維持利率不變，但投資人將尋找未來貨幣政策走向的線索。
根據倫敦證券交易所集團（LSEG）數據，週四股市遭拋售後，聯邦基金利率期貨交易員下調了對聯準會12月升息的押注，但市場仍認為升息機率達81%。
交易員目前預估，歐洲央行12月升息的機率為66%。投資人將仔細檢視任何有關利率前景的訊號。歐洲央行總裁拉加德（Christine Lagarde）9月底曾表示，面對通膨，採取適度的政策反應是合適的。
採購經理人指數（PMI）數據顯示，歐元區民間部門10月成長速度放緩，降至四個月來最疲弱水準，主要受到法國經濟活動再度萎縮拖累。
花旗經濟學家 Giada Giani 表示，「我們認為，這次數據下滑讓PMI回到與其他經濟成長指標一致的水準，而非意味著未來下行風險正在增加。法國仍是拖累因素，但歐元區其他地區依然展現韌性。」
日本方面，週五公布的數據顯示，9月核心消費者物價年增率九個月來首度超過日本央行2%的通膨目標。分析師表示，這項數據顯示價格壓力正擴大至更多領域，也強化日銀近期升息的理由。
交易員目前預估，日本銀行12月升息的機率為61%。

paras_en: The dollar edged higher on Friday (the 23rd), with the DXY showing little change this week. The euro fell as French government bonds were sold off, pushing France's sovereign debt risk premium to its highest level since the Euro‑area crisis of 2011. Both the euro‑dollar and euro‑yen pairs closed the week in the red. The yen benefited from a flight‑to‑safety flow triggered by Thursday’s sell‑off in AI‑related stocks, rising against the dollar over the week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.25% to 101.82, up about 0.03% for the week.

Market worries about escalating domestic turmoil in France and worsening budget issues continued to weigh on the euro. French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said France will deploy 70,000 police officers, supported by special forces, on Saturday to address protests. Moody’s also may downgrade France’s credit rating on Friday.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The pressure on European bond markets has eased today, but Moody’s later review of France’s debt rating remains a challenge. Although the Macron government has threatened to use force to quell social unrest, more activity could still occur over the weekend.”
The euro fell 0.21% against the dollar to $1.1191, down about 0.43% for the week.
The euro‑yen pair slipped further, briefly hitting ¥175.08, the lowest since October 2025, down 0.11% and about 1.1% for the week.
The yen slipped 0.1% to ¥156.9 per dollar, but is up roughly 0.7% for the week, marking its best weekly performance since mid‑September.
Lee Hardman, senior FX analyst at MUFG, said, “With the hedge‑fund atmosphere heating up toward the end of the week, the yen remains firmly on the stronger side.”
Central‑bank policy meetings become market focus

Traders are watching next week’s policy meetings of the U.S. Federal Reserve, the European Central Bank and the Bank of Japan. Markets expect all three central banks to keep rates unchanged, but investors will look for clues on future monetary‑policy direction.

According to data from the London Stock Exchange Group, after Thursday’s equity sell‑off, Fed‑funds futures traders reduced bets on a December rate hike, yet the market still sees an 81% probability of a hike.

Traders currently estimate a 66% chance that the ECB will raise rates in December. Investors will scrutinise any signals about the rate outlook. ECB President Christine Lagarde said at the end of September that a measured policy response to inflation is appropriate.

Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) data showed that euro‑area private‑sector growth slowed in October to its weakest level in four months, mainly dragged down by a renewed contraction in French economic activity.

Citigroup economist Giada Giani said, “We think this data dip brings the PMI back in line with other growth indicators rather than signalling rising downside risk. France remains a drag, but the rest of the euro area continues to show resilience.”

In Japan, Friday’s data showed that September core CPI year‑over‑year finally exceeded the Bank of Japan’s 2% inflation target for the first time in nine months. Analysts said the figure indicates price pressure spreading to more sectors and bolsters the case for a near‑term rate hike by the BOJ.
Traders now assign a 61% probability to a BOJ rate increase in December.

items.title: 美銀Hartnett示警避險潮延續至11月中 股市、美元、殖利率齊跌
items.title_en: Bank of America’s Hartnett Warns Hedge Wave Will Persist Into Mid‑November, Stocks, Dollar and Yields All Falling
paras: 美銀(BAC-US) 策略師Michael Hartnett預期，市場避險情緒可能延續至11月中旬，債券殖利率、股市與美元恐同步下跌。圍繞人工智慧（AI）交易及美國期中選舉的不安情緒，正壓抑股市表現，促使投資人轉向防禦性資產。
Hartnett週五在致客戶的報告中表示：「我們在戰術上維持避險立場至11月中旬。」他預期，市場將出現殖利率下跌、股市下跌及美元下跌的交易格局。
他指出，市場仍須充分反映民主黨同時取得眾議院與參議院控制權的可能性。在他看來，這樣的選舉結果將終結當前低稅、低監管的政策環境，不利企業獲利成長。
至於風險偏好何時可能回升，Hartnett認為，若歐洲央行或法國政府出手扭轉法國公債賣壓，可能成為訊號之一。
近期令市場不安的AI超大規模雲端服務商債券利差，也是一項觀察重點。他表示，若這些企業削減資本支出，或宣布「極大規模」的股權融資，使債券利差見頂，也可能緩解市場壓力。
儘管疑慮升溫，資金仍持續流入AI相關領域。美銀引述EPFR Global數據指出，科技股獲得7月以來最大單週資金流入。美銀本月公布的調查也顯示，全球投資人對科技股的曝險程度，升至2020年8月以來最高。
不過，最近幾天投資人也開始轉向防禦性資產，以因應油價上漲、融資成本攀升，以及AI交易可能逐漸泡沫化等風險。億萬富豪肯．格里芬（Ken Griffin）本週便警告，投資人「幾乎可以肯定」正身處AI泡沫之中。
資金轉向的跡象也反映在類股表現上。作為衡量市場廣度的指標，標普500等權重指數週四相對於市值加權的標普500指數，創下2024年以來最佳單日表現；防禦性較強的民生必需消費品類股，則可望締造1998年以來最佳單月表現。
paras_en: Bank of America (BAC-US) strategist Michael Hartnett expects the market’s hedging sentiment to continue into mid‑November, with bond yields, equities and the dollar likely to fall together. Anxiety surrounding AI‑driven trading and the U.S. midterm elections is suppressing stock performance and pushing investors toward defensive assets.

Hartnett wrote in a client note on Friday: “We will maintain a tactical hedging stance through mid‑November.” He anticipates a trading environment of falling yields, declining equities and a weaker dollar.

He noted that the market still needs to fully price in the possibility that Democrats could control both the House and the Senate. In his view, such an outcome would end the current low‑tax, low‑regulation policy regime, which is unfavorable for corporate profit growth.
As for when risk appetite might rebound, Hartnett sees a potential signal if the European Central Bank or the French government steps in to curb the selling pressure on French sovereign bonds.

Another focus is the widening credit spreads of ultra‑large AI cloud service providers, which have recently unsettled markets. He said that if these firms cut capital expenditures or announce “massive” equity financings that cap spreads, market pressure could ease.

Despite rising concerns, money continues to flow into AI‑related areas. Bank of America cites EPFR Global data showing the biggest weekly inflow into tech stocks since July, and its own survey this month indicating global investors’ exposure to tech stocks has risen to its highest level since August 2020.

However, in recent days investors have begun shifting toward defensive assets to hedge against rising oil prices, higher financing costs and the potential bubble in AI trading. Billionaire Ken Griffin warned this week that investors are “almost certainly” in an AI bubble.

The shift is also reflected in sector performance. As a breadth gauge, the equal‑weight S&P 500 posted its best single‑day performance this year on Thursday relative to the market‑cap‑weighted S&P 500, while defensive consumer‑staples stocks are on track for their strongest monthly gain since 1998.

items.title_en: <New York Forex> Dollar Flat, Yen Strengthens; Oil, AI and French Situation Stir Market Unease
paras: 美元周四(22日)大致持平，日元則有望創下近一個月來最大單日漲幅。由於股市表現脆弱、中東戰事延宕推升原油價格，以及市場對人工智慧（AI）未來投資報酬的疑慮升高，投資人紛紛尋求避險。

Daiwa Capital Markets經濟研究主管Chris Scicluna表示，「AI讓人感到不安，油價也是如此……法國局勢同樣令人擔憂。」
在葉門武裝組織青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯後，市場擔心這個重要能源出口地區的供應將進一步受到干擾，推動油價上漲約3%，升至五個月高點。
日元兌美元升值0.75%，至156.96日元兌1美元。
日元走強的部分原因，也可能與匯價接近160這個關鍵水準有關。市場認為，一旦日元逼近160，日本當局進一步干預匯市、支撐日元的可能性就會升高。
Convera首席外匯與總體經濟策略師Kevin Ford將此稱為「干預溢價」，並指出，「每當日元接近160關卡，市場對央行出手干預的猜測就會升溫。」
在另一傳統避險貨幣瑞士法郎方面，美元兌瑞郎下跌0.42%，至每美元兌0.821瑞郎。
美元走勢愈來愈受到資本流動，以及與AI交易相關的經濟成長和通膨預期影響。上週由於市場對AI前景的疑慮升高，美元走跌，然而，週四市場對法國局勢的擔憂則占了上風。
富國銀行全球外匯策略主管Erik Nelson表示，「目前存在彼此競爭的市場敘事與脆弱環節，一方面是美國與AI相關的信用風險，另一方面則是法國的主權信用風險。過去幾天，這兩項因素持續拉鋸，有時其中一項比另一項更令人擔憂。」
他接著表示，「只要法國的風險比美國AI相關信用風險更受市場擔憂，歐元表現就會相對疲弱。」
法國總統馬克宏(Emmanuel Macron)週四表示，未來幾天將禁止「不合法」的抗議活動，並將上週末的暴動與掠奪事件歸咎於「煽動叛亂的」極左派團體及破壞公物者。
市場對法國能否妥善管理龐大債務負擔的疑慮，已衝擊法國公債，並引發對歐元區其他高負債國家的擔憂。週四，法國與德國10年期公債殖利率利差擴大至177.7個基點，為2011年以來最大。
英鎊兌美元升值0.05%，至1.3401美元。
澳幣兌美元則下跌0.11%，至0.7019美元。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat on Thursday (the 22nd), while the yen is poised to record its biggest single‑day gain in about a month. Weak equity markets, lingering Middle‑East conflict pushing up oil prices, and growing doubts about the future returns on artificial‑intelligence (AI) investments have led investors to seek safe havens.

The euro fell 0.09% against the dollar to $1.1222. Concerns over social unrest in France and the country’s deteriorating fiscal outlook outweighed worries about AI‑driven trading, which has been dragging U.S. equities lower.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, slipped 0.08% to 101.60.
Chris Scicluna, head of economic research at Daiwa Capital Markets, said, “AI is unsettling, oil prices are too… the situation in France is equally worrisome.”
After a Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, markets feared further supply disruptions in this key energy‑export region, pushing oil prices up about 3% to a five‑month high.
The yen rose 0.75% against the dollar to ¥156.96 per $1.

One reason for the yen’s strength may be its approach to the critical ¥160 level. Market participants think that once the yen nears ¥160, Japanese authorities are more likely to intervene in the forex market to support the currency.

Kevin Ford, chief FX and macro strategist at Convera, called this an “intervention premium” and noted, “Whenever the yen approaches the 160 barrier, speculation about central‑bank intervention heats up.”
On another traditional safe‑haven currency, the Swiss franc, the dollar fell 0.42% to 0.821 CHF per $1.

The dollar’s trajectory is increasingly shaped by capital flows and expectations for economic growth and inflation linked to AI trading. Last week, heightened doubts about AI’s outlook pulled the dollar down, but on Thursday market concerns over France took precedence.

Erik Nelson, global FX strategy head at Wells Fargo, said, “There are competing market narratives and fragile points right now: on one side, U.S. AI‑related credit risk; on the other, France’s sovereign credit risk. In recent days these two factors have been tug‑of‑war, with one sometimes outweighing the other.”
He added, “As long as France’s risk is more concerning to the market than U.S. AI‑related credit risk, the euro will remain relatively weak.”
French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday that “illegal” protests would be banned in the coming days, blaming last weekend’s riots and looting on “subversive” far‑left groups and vandals.

Market doubts about France’s ability to manage its massive debt load have hit French government bonds and sparked worries about other highly indebted euro‑area countries. On Thursday the spread between French and German 10‑year yields widened to 177.7 basis points, the widest since 2011.
The pound rose 0.05% against the dollar to $1.3401.
The Australian dollar slipped 0.11% against the dollar to $0.7019.

items.title: 菲律賓央行意外升息2碼 宣示對抗通膨與披索貶值決心
items.title_en: Philippine Central Bank Unexpectedly Raises Rate by 2 Points, Signaling Determination to Combat Inflation and Peso Depreciation
paras: 菲律賓央行(BSP)周四(22日)採取果斷行動，宣布將目標反向附買回利率調升2碼(0.5個百分點)至5.50%，以應對通膨擴大與披索匯率跌至歷史新低的雙重壓力，這項決策遠比市場預期更為激進。
媒體先前調查的25位經濟學家中，多達24位僅預估升息1碼，僅有1位準確預估升息2碼。央行在聲明中表示，價格壓力擴大需要「強烈」的回應，透過決斷的貨幣政策來遏制二次效應並錨定通膨預期，且已做好必要時採取進一步貨幣政策行動的準備。
自今年早些時候伊朗爆發衝突以來，儘管菲律賓經濟正經歷疫情以來最慢的成長步伐，央行已累計升息125個基點(5碼)。然而通膨前景未見顯著改善，9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率衝上7.2%，扭轉了連續4個月的放緩趨勢，使今年以來的平均通膨率達到5.4%，遠高於央行3%的目標。
此外，披索對美元匯率在上周跌破63關卡後續創新低，加劇了依賴進口能源與食品的進口通膨風險。央行維持今年通膨預測於6.1%，但將2027年預測由5.4%顯著調升至6.0%，預計要到2028年才會降至3.3%。
菲律賓央行總裁雷莫洛納(Eli Remolona)表示：「通膨預測比我們預想的還要糟糕，這讓我們感受到壓制通膨壓力的緊迫感。」
雷莫洛納指出，中東局勢升溫推升了國際油價與運輸票價，而未來最大的風險是嚴重的聖嬰現象乾旱可能衝擊農業生產。他同時對披索疲軟及其對進口通膨的影響表達憂慮，但明確表示央行不會耗盡外匯存底來捍衛特定的匯率關卡，並補充指出，在政府支出改善下，國內經濟預計於2027年第一季復甦。
做為唯一精準預測本次決策的專家，菲律賓群島銀行首席經濟學家Emilio Neri Jr.認為，這次大幅升息強化了菲律賓央行對抗通膨的信譽與決心。
不過，Pantheon Macroeconomics經濟學家Miguel Chanco提醒，12月會議是否進一步緊縮仍非定局。他說：「今日超出預期的調整，其動機可能是將今年最後一次會議中原本無爭議的25個基點升息提前實施。」
paras_en: The Philippine central bank (BSP) took decisive action on Thursday (the 22nd), announcing a 2‑point (0.5 percentage‑point) increase in its target reverse repurchase rate to 5.50% to address the dual pressures of widening inflation and the peso sliding to a historic low, a move far more aggressive than markets had expected.

Among the 25 economists surveyed by the media, 24 only forecast a 1‑point hike, with just one correctly predicting a 2‑point increase. In its statement, the bank said that expanding price pressures require a “strong” response, using decisive monetary policy to curb secondary effects and anchor inflation expectations, and it is ready to take further policy action if needed.

Since the outbreak of conflict in Iran earlier this year, even as the Philippine economy has been growing at its slowest pace since the pandemic, the central bank has cumulatively raised rates by 125 basis points (5 points). Yet the inflation outlook has not improved markedly; September’s consumer price index (CPI) rose 7.2% year‑on‑year, reversing four months of slowdown and pushing the year‑to‑date average inflation to 5.4%, well above the bank’s 3% target.

Moreover, after the peso fell below the 63 per‑dollar mark last week and set a new low, import‑driven inflation risks have intensified given the country’s reliance on imported energy and food. The bank kept its 2024 inflation forecast at 6.1% but lifted its 2027 projection sharply from 5.4% to 6.0%, expecting inflation to fall to 3.3% only by 2028.
BSP Governor Eli Remolona said, “The inflation outlook is worse than we anticipated, which makes us feel the urgency of suppressing inflation pressures.”

Remolona noted that heightened tensions in the Middle East have pushed up international oil prices and freight rates, and that the biggest future risk is a severe El Niño‑induced drought that could hit agricultural output. He also expressed concern over the weak peso and its impact on imported inflation, but made clear the bank will not deplete foreign‑exchange reserves to defend a specific exchange‑rate level, adding that, with improved government spending, the domestic economy is expected to recover in the first quarter of 2027.

As the only expert who accurately forecast the decision, Emilio Neri Jr., chief economist at the Bank of the Philippine Islands, said the sharp rate hike reinforces the BSP’s credibility and resolve in fighting inflation.

However, Pantheon Macroeconomics economist Miguel Chanco warned that whether the December meeting will tighten further remains uncertain. He said, “Today’s surprise adjustment may be motivated by moving forward the undisputed 25‑basis‑point hike that was slated for the last meeting of the year.”

items.title: 人工智慧疑慮再起 資金湧入美債、日元與瑞郎避險
items.title_en: AI Concerns Resurface, Funds Flood Into US Treasuries, Yen and Franc as Safe Havens
paras: 由於投資人對人工智慧(AI)交易的獲利前景疑慮再起，導致股市出現震盪，避險資金隨之湧入美國公債、日元及瑞士法郎等避險資產。
美國政府公債殖利率全線下跌至少 3 個基點，其中 30 年期美債殖利率降至 5.38%，創下 9 月 23 日以來最低。同時，澳洲與紐西蘭公債價格也同步走揚，日元兌美元匯率升幅高達 0.3%。
星展銀行(DBS Bank Ltd.)資深利率策略師 Eugene Leow 表示：「隨著投資人重新審視與 AI 相關的資產，近期的市場情緒似乎更加動搖。」他指出，市場對獲利能力與投資報酬率(ROI)的疑慮正在逐漸浮現。在美債殖利率以近期標準衡量仍處於高位的情況下，投資人希望透過轉向美債尋求安全感，以規避部分風險。
股票市場的跌勢，讓美債重新發揮了避險資產的作用；在此之前，對通膨升溫的擔擔曾推動美債殖利率在最近幾周升至多年新高。
儘管沙烏地阿拉伯發生的致命襲擊事件引發市場對供應前景的疑慮，進而推升原油價格，但資金對美債的避險買盤依然強勁。能源成本上升加深了市場對通膨的擔憂，並促使交易員預期美國聯準會(Fed)及全球其他主要中央銀行將進一步升息。
彭博追蹤美債報酬率的指標在 9 月創下近兩年來最大單月跌幅後，10 月已回升約 1.2%。
澳洲國家銀行(National Australia Bank)利率策略主管 Kenneth Crompton 對此指出：「儘管油價一直在緩步上揚，但美債再次吸引了避險資金的流入。」
除美債外，全球其他主要債市與匯市也受到影響。澳洲 10 年期公債殖利率下跌 3 個基點至 5.25%，紐西蘭 2 年期公債殖利率下滑 2 個基點至 3.91%。在匯市方面，日元兌美元升值 0.3% 至 157.68 日元兌 1 美元，瑞士法郎上漲 0.2%，而美元指數指標則變化不大。
法國Credit Agricole策略師 David Forrester 分析：「標普 500 指數期貨的回檔為日元帶來了推升力道。」他強調：「重要之處在於，這種升勢是全面性的，甚至對美元同樣上揚，這凸顯出在 AI 熱潮遭遇波折時，日元所具備的避險資產地位。」
paras_en: Investors' renewed doubts about the profit prospects of AI trading have caused stock market volatility, prompting safe‑haven money to pour into US government bonds, the Japanese yen and the Swiss franc.

US government bond yields fell across the board by at least three basis points, with the 30‑year Treasury yield dropping to 5.38%, the lowest since September 23. At the same time, Australian and New Zealand government bond prices rose, and the yen gained about 0.3% against the dollar.

Eugene Leow, senior rate strategist at DBS Bank Ltd., said: “As investors re‑evaluate AI‑related assets, market sentiment has become more unsettled.” He noted that concerns over profitability and ROI are emerging, and with Treasury yields still high by recent standards, investors are turning to US bonds for safety and to hedge some risk.
The equity market decline has restored the role of Treasuries as a safe‑haven asset; previously, worries about rising inflation had pushed Treasury yields up to multi‑year highs in recent weeks.

Although a deadly attack in Saudi Arabia raised supply‑side concerns and lifted oil prices, buying pressure for US Treasuries remained strong. Higher energy costs have deepened inflation worries and led traders to expect further rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve and other major central banks worldwide.
Bloomberg’s Treasury yield index, after posting the biggest monthly drop in nearly two years in September, has recovered about 1.2% in October.
Kenneth Crompton, head of rate strategy at National Australia Bank, said: “Even though oil prices have been inching higher, US Treasuries are once again attracting safe‑haven flows.”

Beyond Treasuries, other major bond and currency markets were also affected. Australian 10‑year government bond yields fell three basis points to 5.25%, New Zealand two‑year yields slipped two basis points to 3.91%. In the FX market, the yen appreciated 0.3% to 157.68 per dollar, the Swiss franc rose 0.2%, while the US dollar index was largely unchanged.

David Forrester, a strategist at Credit Agricole in France, analyzed: “The pull‑back in S&P 500 futures provided upward momentum for the yen.” He stressed: “The key point is that this rise is broad‑based, even lifting the dollar, highlighting the yen’s safe‑haven status when the AI hype hits a snag.”
